title: 日式土豆炖肉
body:
## 食材

- 土豆：切大块
- 洋葱：顺纹切丝
- 牛小排或薄切牛肉
- 糖、酱油、清酒或味醂、食用油、水

## 做法

### 1. 炒香洋葱

热锅加少量油，放入洋葱，炒至边缘微焦、呈咖啡色。

### 2. 煸炒牛肉

加入牛肉，炒至表面无红色、油脂释出，再加糖炒匀。

### 3. 加入土豆

放入土豆，倒入酱油、清酒或味醂等调味液，加水至与食材齐平。

### 4. 加盖慢炖

用剪成锅口大小的烘焙纸或铝箔纸作落盖，盖在食材上。中小火炖约 25 分钟。

### 5. 收汁出锅

炖至牛肉和土豆软烂、汤汁收浓。用筷子轻戳土豆，确认熟透后出锅。

## 小贴士

- 土豆切大块，炖煮后更容易保持形状。
- 落盖能帮助汤汁循环，使食材均匀入味。
- 可搭配米饭、腌菜或炒青菜。

## 参考链接

- [查看视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1UfWOyM6rNc)
description: 洋葱炒出甜味，牛肉与土豆慢炖入味。
descriptionEn: Sweet onions, tender beef and chunky potatoes simmered in a savory sauce.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Potatoes, cut into large chunks
- Onion, sliced along the grain
- Beef short rib or thinly sliced beef
- Sugar, soy sauce, sake or mirin, cooking oil and water

## Method

### 1. Brown the onion

Heat a little oil in a pan. Add the onion and cook until the edges are lightly browned.

### 2. Cook the beef

Add the beef and stir-fry until no red remains on the surface and some fat has rendered. Add sugar and stir to combine.

### 3. Add the potatoes

Add the potatoes, soy sauce and sake or mirin. Pour in water until it is level with the ingredients.

### 4. Simmer under a drop lid

Cut a piece of baking paper or foil to fit the pan and lay it directly over the ingredients as a drop lid. Simmer over medium-low heat for about 25 minutes.

### 5. Reduce and serve

Cook until the beef and potatoes are tender and the sauce has reduced. Pierce a potato with chopsticks to check that it is cooked through, then serve.

## Tips

- Large potato chunks hold their shape better during simmering.
- A drop lid helps the sauce circulate and season the ingredients evenly.
- Serve with rice, pickles or stir-fried greens.

## References

- [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1UfWOyM6rNc)

title: 阿见版蛋炒饭
body:
## 食材

- 新鲜煮好的米饭：提前搅散
- 鸡蛋 3 个：蛋黄、蛋白分开
- 火腿肠、黄瓜、培根：切丁，黄瓜去瓤
- 玉米粒、甜豆、小葱
- 盐、白胡椒粉、食用油

## 做法

### 1. 处理米饭

将米饭搅散。蛋黄打散后倒入米饭，拌至饭粒均匀裹上蛋液；蛋白单独搅散备用。

### 2. 准备配料

火腿肠、黄瓜、培根切丁，小葱切葱花。玉米粒和甜豆放入加盐、加油的沸水中，焯至浮起后捞出。

### 3. 煸炒辅料

锅中加油，放入火腿肠和玉米粒炒香，盛出备用。

### 4. 炒蛋白

锅中留底油，小火炒蛋白至凝固，用锅铲分成小块。

### 5. 炒散米饭

加入拌好蛋黄的米饭，大火翻炒，炒至饭粒干爽、不粘锅。

### 6. 合炒调味

加入火腿肠、黄瓜、玉米、甜豆和培根丁，翻炒均匀。加少量盐和白胡椒粉，撒葱花炒匀后出锅。

## 小贴士

- 米饭煮得稍硬一些，炒时更容易粒粒分明。
- 配料较多，调味宜清淡。

## 参考链接

- [查看视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VCELAeG3lyI)
description: 蛋黄裹饭、蛋白单炒，搭配多种蔬菜和肉类配料。
descriptionEn: Yolk-coated rice and separately cooked egg whites with vegetables, ham sausage and bacon.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Freshly cooked rice, loosened in advance
- 3 eggs, yolks and whites separated
- Ham sausage, cucumber and bacon, diced; remove the cucumber seeds
- Corn kernels, sweet peas and scallions
- Salt, white pepper and cooking oil

## Method

### 1. Prepare the rice and eggs

Loosen the rice. Beat the yolks, then mix them into the rice until the grains are evenly coated. Beat the whites separately and set aside.

### 2. Prepare the other ingredients

Dice the ham sausage, cucumber and bacon. Chop the scallions. Blanch the corn and sweet peas in boiling water with salt and oil until they float, then drain.

### 3. Stir-fry the ham and corn

Heat oil in a pan. Stir-fry the ham sausage and corn until fragrant, then remove.

### 4. Cook the egg whites

Leave a little oil in the pan. Cook the egg whites over low heat until set, breaking them into small pieces.

### 5. Fry the rice

Add the yolk-coated rice and stir-fry over high heat until the grains are dry, separate and no longer stick to the pan.

### 6. Combine and season

Add the ham sausage, cucumber, corn, peas and bacon. Stir-fry together, season lightly with salt and white pepper, then add scallions and toss before serving.

## Tips

- Rice cooked slightly firm separates more easily when fried.
- Keep the seasoning light to suit the variety of ingredients.

## References

- [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VCELAeG3lyI)

title: 虾仁蛋炒饭
body:
## 食材

- 带壳虾：虾肉、虾壳分开处理
- 冷米饭、鸡蛋、葱
- 盐、食用油、水

## 做法

### 1. 熬虾汤

虾壳入锅炒至熟透、香味释出，压碎后加适量水煮出虾汤，过滤备用。虾油留作炒制使用。

### 2. 炒虾

锅中加油，放入虾肉，加少量水和虾油煎炒，炒出香气。也可省略单独炒虾，改为与鸡蛋一起炒。

### 3. 炒蛋炒饭

另起锅加少量虾油，放葱炒香，再加入鸡蛋和冷米饭，用锅铲炒散。

### 4. 分次加汤

少量、多次加入虾汤，边加边炒，让饭粒吸收汤汁，避免一次倒入过多。

### 5. 调味出锅

加入盐和虾汁，炒至饭粒干爽。最后补少量虾油，炒匀出锅。

## 小贴士

- 虾汤要分次加入，避免米饭变湿、结团。
- 米饭要粒粒分明，但不要炒得过干；让饭粒吸收虾汤的鲜味。

## 参考链接

- [查看视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5SuekA2ucsU)
description: 用虾壳熬出虾汤，分次加入米饭，突出鲜虾风味。
descriptionEn: Shrimp-shell broth is added a little at a time for richly flavored rice.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Shell-on shrimp; separate the meat and shells
- Cold cooked rice, eggs and scallions
- Salt, cooking oil and water

## Method

### 1. Make the shrimp broth

Stir-fry the shrimp shells until fully cooked and fragrant. Crush them, add water and simmer to make a broth, then strain. Reserve the shrimp oil for frying.

### 2. Cook the shrimp

Heat oil in a pan. Add the shrimp meat with a little water and shrimp oil, and stir-fry until fragrant. Alternatively, skip this separate step and cook the shrimp with the eggs.

### 3. Fry the eggs and rice

In another pan, heat a little shrimp oil. Fry the scallions, then add the eggs and cold rice. Break up the rice with a spatula.

### 4. Add broth gradually

Add the shrimp broth in small additions, stir-frying as you go so the rice absorbs the liquid. Do not pour in too much at once.

### 5. Season and serve

Add salt and shrimp juices. Continue stir-frying until the grains are dry. Finish with a little shrimp oil, toss and serve.

## Tips

- Add the shrimp broth gradually to avoid wet, clumped rice.
- Keep the grains separate without frying them excessively dry; let the rice absorb the flavor of the shrimp broth.

## References

- [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5SuekA2ucsU)

title: 鸡蛋炒米粉
body:
## 食材

- 米粉（原做法使用阿里加香米粉）
- 鸡蛋 1 个
- 豆芽、葱白、葱叶、葱头
- 盐、生抽、食用油

## 做法

### 1. 焯煮米粉

锅中水烧开，加少量油和盐，放入米粉搅散。煮约 2 分钟，水再次沸腾时捞出。

### 2. 焖发米粉

米粉控水后放入盆中，加盖焖 3 分钟，翻面后再焖 3 分钟。

### 3. 准备配料

豆芽洗净沥干，葱切段，葱头切开。鸡蛋加适量盐打散。

### 4. 炒鸡蛋

热锅加油，倒入蛋液，炒至刚成形后盛出。

### 5. 炒香米粉

原锅加油，下米粉稍煎并翻面，再用筷子抖散，炒出米香和微微焦香。

### 6. 合炒调味

依次加入鸡蛋、葱白和豆芽，加生抽炒匀。最后加入葱叶，关火拌匀出锅。

## 小贴士

- 焖发后的米粉应干爽、有弹性，不湿黏。
- 炒米粉时配合使用锅铲和筷子，更容易抖散。

## 参考链接

- [查看视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uw4tSDT-ElU)
description: 先焖发再炒制，让米粉干爽有弹性。
descriptionEn: Rest the briefly boiled noodles under a lid, then stir-fry for a dry, springy texture.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Rice vermicelli; the original method uses Alijia fragrant rice vermicelli
- 1 egg
- Bean sprouts, scallion whites and greens, and congtou (aromatic allium bulbs)
- Salt, light soy sauce and cooking oil

## Method

### 1. Briefly boil the noodles

Bring water to a boil with a little oil and salt. Add the rice vermicelli and loosen it. Cook for about 2 minutes; drain when the water returns to a boil.

### 2. Rest under a lid

Drain the noodles into a bowl. Cover for 3 minutes, turn them over, then cover for another 3 minutes.

### 3. Prepare the other ingredients

Wash and drain the bean sprouts. Cut the scallions into lengths and split the congtou bulbs. Beat the egg with salt.

### 4. Cook the egg

Heat oil in a pan. Add the egg and cook until just set, then remove.

### 5. Fry the noodles

Add oil to the same pan. Spread out the noodles, let them fry briefly, then turn them over. Use chopsticks to loosen them and fry until fragrant and lightly toasted.

### 6. Combine and season

Add the egg, scallion whites and bean sprouts in that order. Season with light soy sauce. Add the scallion greens, turn off the heat and toss before serving.

## Tips

- After resting, the noodles should be springy and relatively dry, rather than wet and sticky.
- Use a spatula together with chopsticks to loosen the noodles.

## References

- [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uw4tSDT-ElU)

title: 烧椒皮蛋炒饭
body:
## 食材

- 绿辣椒 2 根、糯米椒 3 根
- 皮蛋、鸡蛋、米饭、葱花
- 花椒油、酱油或酱油膏、白胡椒粉、香油
- 盐、食用油

## 做法

### 1. 烤辣椒

将辣椒烤至表皮焦黑，放入碗中，盖保鲜膜焖至表皮变软，再剥皮。可留少许焦皮增加香气。

### 2. 拌皮蛋酱

皮蛋去壳压碎，与辣椒、葱花、花椒油、酱油、白胡椒粉和香油拌匀。

### 3. 炒蛋炒饭

锅烧热后加油，打入鸡蛋，先让蛋液受热出香，再加入米饭炒散、炒干水分。

### 4. 加入酱料

放入葱花，再加约 1 匙皮蛋辣椒酱，翻炒均匀。

### 5. 调味出锅

根据口味补少量酱油、盐和白胡椒粉，炒匀出锅。

## 小贴士

- 皮蛋酱也可用于拌面或作蘸酱。
- 想增加皮蛋风味，可在装盘后搭配少量皮蛋酱。

## 参考链接

- [查看视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kItDG3GaLSk)
titleEn: Charred pepper and century egg fried rice
description: 焦香辣椒拌入皮蛋酱，再与蛋炒饭合炒。
descriptionEn: Charred green peppers and century egg make a fragrant fried-rice relish.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- 2 green chilies and 3 nuomijiao peppers (mild green peppers)
- Century eggs, eggs, cooked rice and chopped scallions
- Sichuan pepper oil, soy sauce or thick soy sauce, white pepper and sesame oil
- Salt and cooking oil

## Method

### 1. Char the peppers

Roast the peppers until the skins are blackened. Place in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and let the skins soften, then peel. Leave a little charred skin for flavor if desired.

### 2. Make the century-egg relish

Peel and crush the century eggs. Mix with the peppers, scallions, Sichuan pepper oil, soy sauce, white pepper and sesame oil.

### 3. Fry the eggs and rice

Heat the pan, then add oil and crack in the eggs. Let them cook briefly to develop aroma before adding the rice. Break up the rice and fry off excess moisture.

### 4. Add the relish

Add scallions and about 1 spoonful of the century-egg relish. Stir-fry to combine.

### 5. Adjust the seasoning

Add a little soy sauce, salt and white pepper to taste. Toss and serve.

## Tips

- The relish also works with noodles or as a dipping sauce.
- For a stronger century-egg flavor, serve a little extra relish alongside the rice.

## References

- [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kItDG3GaLSk)

title: 红烧茄子
body:
## 食材

- 紫皮茄子数根、瘦肉适量
- 青龙椒、蒜
- 盐、白醋、蒜蓉鲜调味料、胡椒粉、白糖
- 老抽、生抽、食用油
- 玉米淀粉、水

## 做法

### 1. 处理茄子

茄子用淡盐水洗净，去蒂切滚刀块。加盐和白醋拌匀，腌 10 分钟，再洗去盐分，充分挤干水分。

### 2. 准备配料

瘦肉剁成肉末，青椒切斜片，蒜拍碎切末。

### 3. 调料汁

将盐、蒜蓉鲜、胡椒粉、白糖、老抽、生抽和食用油拌匀。另用玉米淀粉和水调成水淀粉。

### 4. 炒软茄子

热锅加油，放入茄子，炒软、炒至变色后盛出。

### 5. 炒香肉末

锅留底油，放入肉末和蒜末，炒至肉末变色、香味释出。

### 6. 合炒收汁

加入青椒和料汁，大火烧开，放回茄子炒匀。倒入水淀粉，炒至汤汁包裹茄子后出锅。

## 小贴士

- 茄子腌后洗去盐分，再充分挤干水分。

## 参考链接

- [查看视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x6Uit9bmN-g)
description: 茄子先腌后炒，配肉末和酱汁烧至软嫩入味。
descriptionEn: Salted eggplant is stir-fried with minced meat and a savory sauce.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Several purple eggplants and some lean meat
- Qinglong green peppers and garlic
- Salt, white vinegar, Suanrongxian garlic seasoning, pepper and sugar
- Dark soy sauce, light soy sauce and cooking oil
- Cornstarch and water

## Method

### 1. Prepare the eggplant

Wash the eggplant in lightly salted water. Remove the stems and cut into rolling-cut chunks. Mix with salt and white vinegar, leave for 10 minutes, rinse off the salt and squeeze out as much water as possible.

### 2. Prepare the other ingredients

Mince the meat. Slice the green peppers diagonally and crush and mince the garlic.

### 3. Mix the sauce

Combine salt, garlic seasoning, pepper, sugar, dark soy sauce, light soy sauce and oil. Separately mix cornstarch with water to make a slurry.

### 4. Cook the eggplant

Heat oil in a pan. Stir-fry the eggplant until softened and changed in color, then remove.

### 5. Cook the meat

Leave a little oil in the pan. Add the minced meat and garlic and stir-fry until the meat changes color and becomes fragrant.

### 6. Combine and thicken

Add the peppers and sauce and bring to a boil over high heat. Return the eggplant and toss. Add the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce coats the eggplant, then serve.

## Tips

- Rinse off the salt after marinating the eggplant, then squeeze out the water thoroughly.

## References

- [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x6Uit9bmN-g)

title: 星洲炒米粉
body:
## 食材

- 排米粉 150 克、叉烧约 100 克
- 盐渍虾、鸡蛋 2 个、豆芽约 100 克
- 韭黄 30～50 克、青红椒、洋葱、葱头、葱白、葱叶
- 油咖喱 20 克、姜黄粉 5 克、桂林辣椒酱 10 克
- 水或料酒 15 克（调酱用）
- 盐、食用油

## 做法

### 1. 处理米粉

水中加盐 3～5 克、油 8～10 克，放入米粉，煮 1～2 分钟至略软后捞出，加盖利用余温焖软。

### 2. 准备配料

盐渍虾焯水约 10 秒。叉烧焯水去除表面糖分，切条或片。青红椒和洋葱切条，葱和韭黄切段，鸡蛋打散。

### 3. 调咖喱酱

油咖喱、姜黄粉和桂林辣椒酱拌匀；如太稠，加水或料酒 15 克调至可流动。

### 4. 分别炒配料

锅中加约 10 克油，炒熟鸡蛋后盛出。虾仁大火炒约半分钟，盛出。再加约 5 克油，炒香洋葱，加入青红椒、盐 2 克和豆芽，炒至略软后盛出摊凉。

### 5. 炒香米粉

锅中加油 5～6 克，放入米粉铺平稍煎，翻面炒至略焦、干香。米粉过长时可用锅铲切断。

### 6. 拌酱合炒

关火，加入咖喱酱拌匀，再开火炒香。加入葱头和炒好的配料，包括叉烧，快速翻炒。

### 7. 收尾出锅

加入葱段和韭黄，利用余温炒熟后装盘。

## 小贴士

- 米粉不必在焯煮时完全煮熟。
- 锅底发白、冒烟时转小火，避免炒焦。
- 叉烧先焯水，有助于减少炒制时粘锅。

## 参考链接

- [查看视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wgZPifWWNmc)
description: 咖喱酱拌匀米粉，搭配虾仁、叉烧和蔬菜。
descriptionEn: Curry-seasoned rice noodles with shrimp, char siu and vegetables.
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- 150 g rice vermicelli and about 100 g char siu pork
- Salted shrimp, 2 eggs and about 100 g bean sprouts
- 30–50 g yellow garlic chives, green and red peppers, onion, congtou (aromatic allium bulbs), scallion whites and greens
- 20 g oil-based curry paste, 5 g turmeric and 10 g Guilin chili sauce
- 15 g water or cooking wine, for loosening the sauce
- Salt and cooking oil

## Method

### 1. Prepare the noodles

Add 3–5 g salt and 8–10 g oil to boiling water. Add the noodles and cook for 1–2 minutes until slightly softened. Drain and cover so residual heat softens them further.

### 2. Prepare the other ingredients

Blanch the salted shrimp for about 10 seconds. Blanch the char siu to remove surface sugar, then slice. Cut the peppers and onion into strips, cut the scallions and chives into lengths, and beat the eggs.

### 3. Mix the curry sauce

Mix the curry paste, turmeric and Guilin chili sauce. If too thick, add 15 g water or cooking wine until it flows.

### 4. Cook the additions separately

Heat about 10 g oil and scramble the eggs, then remove. Stir-fry the shrimp over high heat for about half a minute and remove. Add about 5 g oil, fry the onion, then add the peppers, 2 g salt and bean sprouts. Fry until slightly softened, then spread out to cool.

### 5. Fry the noodles

Heat 5–6 g oil. Spread out the noodles, let them fry briefly, then turn them and fry until dry, fragrant and lightly toasted. Cut very long strands with a spatula if needed.

### 6. Add the sauce and other ingredients

Turn off the heat and mix in the curry sauce. Turn the heat back on and fry until fragrant. Add the congtou bulbs and cooked additions, including the char siu, and toss quickly.

### 7. Finish and serve

Add the scallion lengths and yellow garlic chives. Let residual heat cook them, then serve.

## Tips

- The noodles do not need to be fully cooked during the initial boiling.
- Lower the heat if the pan starts to turn white and smoke, to avoid burning the noodles.
- Blanching the char siu first helps prevent its sugary surface from sticking.

## References

- [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wgZPifWWNmc)

title: 海鲜粉丝煲
body:
## 食材

- 粉丝、大虾
- 鸡蛋 1 个、蒜末、葱花
- 青椒丝、胡萝卜丝等配菜
- 老抽 1/3 勺、生抽 4 勺（分两次使用）
- 蚝油 1 勺、白胡椒粉适量、食用油

## 做法

### 1. 处理粉丝

粉丝用开水泡 20 秒，捞出后立即放冷水中泡 10 分钟。沥干、剪段，加老抽 1/3 勺和生抽 2 勺拌匀。

### 2. 准备虾和碗汁

大虾去头、去壳，保留虾尾，开背去虾线。虾头留用。生抽 2 勺、蚝油 1 勺和白胡椒粉拌成碗汁。

### 3. 煎虾油

热锅加油，小火煎虾头至金黄酥脆，捞出虾头，保留虾油。

### 4. 炒蛋和配菜

虾油中加入蒜末，打入鸡蛋炒散，再下青椒丝、胡萝卜丝等配菜，炒至八成熟。

### 5. 合炒粉丝和虾

放入粉丝，用筷子炒拌约 1 分钟，加入虾肉。倒入碗汁，快速翻炒，出锅前撒葱花。

### 6. 装入砂锅

将炒好的粉丝装入提前预热的砂锅，即可上桌。

## 小贴士

- 粉丝先短泡、再过冷水，有助于保持弹性。
- 粉丝入锅后及时抖散，避免结块。

## Ingredients

- Glass noodles and large shrimp
- 1 egg, minced garlic and chopped scallions
- Shredded green pepper, carrot or similar vegetables
- 1/3 spoonful dark soy sauce and 4 spoonfuls light soy sauce, divided
- 1 spoonful oyster sauce, white pepper to taste and cooking oil

## Method

### 1. Prepare the glass noodles

Soak the noodles in boiling water for 20 seconds, then immediately transfer to cold water for 10 minutes. Drain and cut into shorter lengths. Mix with 1/3 spoonful dark soy sauce and 2 spoonfuls light soy sauce.

### 2. Prepare the shrimp and sauce

Remove the shrimp heads and shells, keeping the tails. Slit the backs and remove the veins. Reserve the heads. Mix 2 spoonfuls light soy sauce, 1 spoonful oyster sauce and white pepper for the sauce.

### 3. Make the shrimp oil

Heat oil in a pan. Fry the shrimp heads over low heat until golden and crisp, then remove them, leaving the flavored oil.

### 4. Cook the egg and vegetables

Add garlic to the shrimp oil. Crack in the egg and scramble it. Add the shredded vegetables and cook until nearly cooked.

### 5. Combine noodles and shrimp

Add the noodles and toss with chopsticks for about 1 minute, then add the shrimp meat. Pour in the sauce and stir-fry quickly. Add scallions just before serving.

### 6. Transfer to the clay pot

Transfer the noodles to a preheated clay pot and serve.

## Tips

- Brief hot soaking followed by cold water helps the glass noodles stay springy.
- Loosen the noodles promptly in the pan to prevent clumping.

title: 茄子炒鸡蛋
body:
## 食材

- 茄子 2 根、鸡蛋 2 个
- 蒜、姜、小米辣、青椒、番茄
- 盐、鸡精、胡椒粉、蚝油、生抽
- 玉米淀粉、水、食用油

## 做法

### 1. 处理茄子

茄子去蒂，切约 1 厘米的小方块，加盐抓匀，腌 20 分钟。冲洗 2 遍，充分沥干。

### 2. 准备配料和料汁

蒜姜切末，小米辣切圈，青椒和番茄切小块。盐、鸡精、胡椒粉、蚝油、生抽、玉米淀粉和水拌成料汁。

### 3. 炒鸡蛋

鸡蛋加胡椒粉，顺一个方向搅匀。热锅加少量油，小火煎炒成块后盛出。

### 4. 炒熟茄子

另加少量油，放入茄子，慢火煎炒至熟，盛出备用。

### 5. 炒香配菜

锅中加油，爆香蒜末、姜末和小米辣，放入番茄炒出汁，再加青椒快速翻炒。

### 6. 合炒出锅

鸡蛋和茄子回锅，倒入料汁，大火炒匀，待酱汁均匀裹住食材后出锅。

## Ingredients

- 2 eggplants and 2 eggs
- Garlic, ginger, small hot chilies, green pepper and tomato
- Salt, chicken bouillon seasoning, pepper, oyster sauce and light soy sauce
- Cornstarch, water and cooking oil

## Method

### 1. Prepare the eggplant

Remove the stems and cut the eggplant into cubes about 1 cm wide. Rub with salt and leave for 20 minutes. Rinse 2 times and drain thoroughly.

### 2. Prepare the additions and sauce

Mince the garlic and ginger, slice the chilies into rings, and dice the pepper and tomato. Mix salt, chicken seasoning, pepper, oyster sauce, light soy sauce, cornstarch and water into a sauce.

### 3. Cook the eggs

Beat the eggs with pepper, stirring in one direction. Heat a little oil and cook the eggs over low heat until they form pieces, then remove.

### 4. Cook the eggplant

Add a little oil and slowly pan-fry and stir-fry the eggplant until cooked. Remove and set aside.

### 5. Cook the vegetables

Add oil and fry the garlic, ginger and chilies until fragrant. Add the tomato and cook until juicy, then add the green pepper and stir-fry quickly.

Return the eggs and eggplant. Add the sauce and stir-fry over high heat until the ingredients are evenly coated, then serve.

title: 泡面的 10 种做法
body:
## 做法

### 1. 牛肉丸泡面

1. 冷水中放入牛肉丸，无需解冻，煮至沸腾。
2. 加入泡面和粉包。
3. 面快熟时加入两条青菜，出锅前加入葱油包和生抽调味。

小贴士：牛肉丸煮出的汤汁可作为面汤。

### 2. 沙茶花生牛奶泡面

1. 锅中放 2 勺沙茶酱炒香。
2. 加入开水、1 小勺花生酱和半杯牛奶。
3. 放入泡面煮熟，粉包按口味少量加入。

小贴士：沙茶酱、花生酱和牛奶共同构成浓郁汤底。

### 3. 广式姜葱拌面

1. 碗中放姜丝和葱花，淋上热花生油。
2. 加入鸡味泡面调料粉，拌成酱汁。
3. 泡面煮熟沥水，与酱汁拌匀。剩余粉包可兑热水作汤。

小贴士：姜葱油在拌面前调好。

### 4. 鸡蛋羹泡面

1. 鸡蛋打散，倒入少量泡面汤拌匀。
2. 撇去泡沫，放入微波炉，低火加热 1 分 30 秒。
3. 淋少量芝麻油和酱油。

小贴士：加热效果随微波炉功率和蛋液用量变化，以蛋液凝固为准。

### 5. 煎蛋火腿香辣泡面

1. 锅中煎鸡蛋和火腿肠，煎至表面焦香。
2. 加水煮沸，放入泡面和调料包，煮熟即可。

小贴士：先煎后煮，让汤底带上煎蛋和火腿的香味。

### 6. 旋涡荷包蛋泡面

1. 水烧开，加入调料粉搅匀。
2. 转小火，搅出旋涡，打入鸡蛋。
3. 等鸡蛋中心定形，再下泡面煮熟。

小贴士：鸡蛋定形前不要急着翻动。

### 7. 咸蛋黄火腿汤泡面

1. 热锅加油，炒香姜片，放入咸蛋黄，炒至起沙。
2. 加入火腿肠、热水和泡面。
3. 可加入白菜、豆腐等配菜，煮熟即可。

小贴士：咸蛋黄本身有咸味，粉包酌量添加。

### 8. 皮蛋香菜泡面

1. 锅中炒香姜片、皮蛋和火腿肠末。
2. 加入开水和泡面粉包，放入泡面煮熟。
3. 最后撒入香菜。

小贴士：香菜在出锅前加入。

### 9. 咖喱土豆泡面

1. 土豆煎透，加入咖喱块炒香。
2. 倒入适量热水，放入泡面煮熟。

小贴士：咖喱块已有调味，可不加粉包。

### 10. 番茄炒泡面

1. 番茄去皮切碎。锅中炒香蒜末，加入番茄炒出汁。
2. 加入番茄泡面调味包和热水。
3. 加入鸡蛋和泡面，炒煮至熟。

小贴士：重口味变体可加入豆豉辣酱、豆腐或腊肠一起炒。

descriptionEn: Ten variations, from brothy noodles to aromatic tossed noodles.
bodyEn:
## Method

### 1. Beef-ball noodle soup

1. Put frozen beef balls straight into cold water and bring to a boil.
2. Add the instant noodles and seasoning powder.
3. When the noodles are nearly cooked, add two leafy greens. Add the scallion oil sachet and light soy sauce before serving.

Tip: The beef-ball cooking liquid becomes the noodle broth.

### 2. Shacha, peanut and milk noodles

1. Fry 2 spoonfuls shacha sauce until fragrant.
2. Add boiling water, 1 small spoonful peanut butter and half a cup of milk.
3. Add the noodles and cook through. Add only a little seasoning powder to taste.

Tip: The shacha sauce, peanut butter and milk make a rich broth.

### 3. Cantonese ginger-scallion tossed noodles

1. Put shredded ginger and chopped scallions in a bowl and pour hot peanut oil over them.
2. Mix in chicken-flavored instant-noodle seasoning powder to make a sauce.
3. Cook and drain the noodles, then toss with the sauce. Any remaining seasoning powder can be dissolved in hot water for soup.

Tip: Prepare the ginger-scallion oil before tossing the noodles.

### 4. Egg custard with noodle broth

1. Beat the egg and mix in a little instant-noodle broth.
2. Skim off the bubbles and microwave on low power for 1 minute 30 seconds.
3. Drizzle with a little sesame oil and soy sauce.

Tip: Heating varies with microwave power and the amount of egg mixture; check that the egg has set.

### 5. Fried egg and ham spicy noodles

1. Pan-fry the egg and ham sausage until lightly browned and fragrant.
2. Add water and bring to a boil. Add the noodles and seasoning sachets and cook through.

Tip: Frying first adds egg and ham flavor to the broth.

### 6. Swirled poached-egg noodles

1. Bring water to a boil and stir in the seasoning powder.
2. Lower the heat, stir a vortex into the water and crack in the egg.
3. Wait for the center of the egg to set, then add the noodles and cook through.

Tip: Do not stir the egg before it has set.

### 7. Salted egg yolk and ham noodle soup

1. Heat oil, fry the ginger until fragrant, then add salted egg yolk and cook until grainy.
2. Add ham sausage, hot water and the noodles.
3. Add vegetables such as Chinese cabbage or tofu if desired and cook through.

Tip: Salted egg yolk is already salty; use the seasoning powder sparingly.

### 8. Century egg and cilantro noodles

1. Fry ginger, century egg and finely chopped ham sausage until fragrant.
2. Add boiling water and seasoning powder, then cook the noodles in the broth.
3. Scatter with cilantro at the end.

Tip: Add the cilantro just before serving.

### 9. Curry and potato noodles

1. Pan-fry the potatoes until cooked through, then add a curry block and fry until fragrant.
2. Add hot water and cook the noodles in the broth.

Tip: Curry blocks are already seasoned, so the powder sachet can be omitted.

### 10. Tomato stir-fried instant noodles

1. Peel and finely chop the tomatoes. Fry garlic until fragrant, then add the tomatoes and cook until juicy.
2. Add tomato-flavored noodle seasoning and hot water.
3. Add egg and noodles and cook, stirring, until done.

Tip: For a stronger-flavored variation, stir-fry fermented-black-bean chili sauce with tofu or cured sausage together with the noodles.

title: 清蒸黄花鱼
body:
## 食材

- 黄花鱼 1 条
- 蒜 3～4 瓣：切末
- 葱、姜：切丝；小米椒 2～3 个：切粒
- 蒸鱼豉油 2 汤匙、料酒 1 茶匙
- 盐适量、热油 1～2 汤匙

## 做法

### 1. 处理鱼身

黄花鱼去鳞、内脏和鳃，洗净沥干，两侧每隔约半厘米划一刀。

### 2. 腌鱼

将蒜末和盐拌匀，抹在鱼身和刀口处，腌 20 分钟。

### 3. 准备蒸制

鱼身铺葱姜丝，淋料酒。另用小碗盛蒸鱼豉油，与鱼一起入锅。

### 4. 蒸鱼

水开后上锅，大火蒸 8 分钟，再转小火蒸 2～3 分钟。取出后去掉原来的葱姜。

### 5. 淋油调味

撒上新鲜葱姜丝和小米椒，淋热蒸鱼豉油，再浇八九成热的油。

bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- 1 yellow croaker
- 3–4 garlic cloves, minced
- Scallions and ginger, shredded; 2–3 small hot chilies, finely diced
- 2 tablespoons steamed-fish soy sauce and 1 teaspoon cooking wine
- Salt to taste and 1–2 tablespoons hot oil

## Method

### 1. Prepare the fish

Scale and gut the fish and remove the gills. Wash and drain. Score both sides at intervals of about half a centimeter.

### 2. Marinate

Mix the garlic and salt. Rub over the fish and into the cuts. Leave for 20 minutes.

### 3. Prepare to steam

Lay scallion and ginger over the fish and drizzle with cooking wine. Put the steamed-fish soy sauce in a small bowl and steam it alongside the fish.

### 4. Steam the fish

Once the water boils, steam over high heat for 8 minutes, then over low heat for another 2–3 minutes. Remove the fish and discard the used scallion and ginger.

### 5. Finish with hot oil

Add fresh shredded scallion, ginger and finely diced chili. Pour over the hot soy sauce, then drizzle with very hot oil.

title: 豆豉蒸排骨
body:
## 食材

- 猪肋排 500 克、土豆 1 个：切片
- 蒜末 2 勺、豆豉半勺
- 生抽 2 勺、蚝油 1 勺、生粉 1 勺
- 白糖、盐少许、食用油
- 面粉、水：清洗排骨用

### 1. 清洗排骨

排骨加面粉和水，反复抓洗 2 分钟，再用清水冲净，沥干。

蒜末和豆豉放碗中，淋热油激香，再加生抽、蚝油、白糖和盐拌匀。

### 3. 腌排骨

酱料倒入排骨，加生粉抓匀，腌约 30 分钟。

蒸盘底部铺土豆片，再均匀铺上排骨。

水开后入锅，大火蒸 25 分钟，蒸熟后取出。

title: 虾仁滑蛋
body:
## 食材

- 鸡蛋 4 个、虾仁 200 克
- 小葱适量：切葱花
- 料酒 2 茶匙、盐 1.5 茶匙（分两次使用）
- 淀粉 2 茶匙：加水调成水淀粉
- 食用油

## 做法

### 1. 腌虾仁

虾仁洗净擦干，加料酒 2 茶匙、盐 1 茶匙，腌制片刻。

### 2. 炒熟虾仁

热锅加油，虾仁大火快炒至变色、熟透，连同汤汁和油一起盛出放凉。

### 3. 调蛋液

鸡蛋加剩余的盐 0.5 茶匙打散，蛋白和蛋黄混合即可，不必过度搅打。

### 4. 拌入虾仁

将虾仁、汤汁、油和水淀粉倒入蛋液，拌匀。

### 5. 余温炒蛋

锅中多放些油，烧至冒烟后关火，倒入蛋液，用余温快速翻炒。边缘凝固时轻轻推散。

### 6. 出锅

蛋液刚好不流动时出锅，撒上葱花。

bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- 4 eggs and 200 g shrimp
- Scallions to taste, finely chopped
- 2 teaspoons cooking wine and 1.5 teaspoons salt, divided
- 2 teaspoons starch, mixed with water into a slurry
- Cooking oil

## Method

### 1. Marinate the shrimp

Wash and dry the shrimp. Add 2 teaspoons cooking wine and 1 teaspoon salt, then marinate briefly.

### 2. Cook the shrimp

Heat oil and stir-fry the shrimp over high heat until they change color and are cooked through. Remove with their juices and oil and leave to cool.

### 3. Mix the eggs

Beat the eggs with the remaining 0.5 teaspoon salt just until the whites and yolks combine. Do not overbeat.

Mix the shrimp, juices, oil and starch slurry into the egg mixture.

### 5. Cook with residual heat

Use a generous amount of oil. Heat until it begins to smoke, turn off the heat, then add the egg mixture. Stir and fold quickly using the residual heat, gently breaking up the edges as they set.

### 6. Serve

Remove as soon as the egg mixture stops flowing. Scatter with scallions.

title: 脆皮香煎三文鱼

descriptionEn: Salt ahead, dry thoroughly and sear over medium heat; finish with butter off the heat.
body:
## 食材

- 带皮三文鱼、盐、食用油
- 黄油
- 酱油数滴、柠檬汁数滴：可选
- 附赠吃法：熟三文鱼、米饭、豆乳味噌酱

## 做法

### 1. 擦干鱼身

用厨房纸吸干鱼肉和鱼皮表面水分，避免带着渗出液下锅。

### 2. 提前盐渍

烹饪前 10 分钟撒盐，随后再次吸干析出的水分。鱼皮可浅划 1～2 刀，避免划得过深；此步骤可省略。

### 3. 预热锅并铺油

先预热平底锅，再加食用油，让油覆盖锅面。

### 4. 鱼皮朝下贴锅

中火放入三文鱼，鱼皮朝下。若鱼皮翘起，开始时轻压，待鱼皮定形就松开。

### 5. 等待自然脱锅再翻面

不要刚下锅就移动鱼块。等鱼皮定形、上色并能自然脱离锅面，再翻面继续温和煎熟。

### 6. 关火后增香

鱼煎好后关火，加黄油，用余温融化。可加数滴酱油，把黄油酱汁舀到鱼肉上。装盘后可滴少许柠檬汁。

### 7. 附赠：三文鱼饭碗

将熟三文鱼拆成小块，铺在米饭上，搭配豆乳味噌酱。

## 小贴士

- 擦干鱼身与盐渍后析出的水分，有助于减轻异味、改善上色；带着水分下锅容易影响煎香。
- 提前撒盐，让盐有时间进入鱼肉，同时带出多余水分；只在下锅前撒盐，调味容易停留在表面。
- 鱼皮浅划刀可以减轻受热收缩，让鱼皮更均匀地接触锅面；划得太深会让脂肪流失，这一步也可以省略。
- 预热并铺匀油，有助于减少粘锅。带皮鱼从皮面开始煎，起初轻压翘起处，定形后就松开。
- 刚下锅就移动，鱼皮尚未定形，容易粘住并撕裂。等它自然脱锅再翻面；不带皮的鱼也应等表面定形后再移动。
- 大火急煎或煎得过久，会让鱼肉失去水分和脂肪，口感变干；用温和中火，观察鱼皮上色与鱼肉熟度。
- 黄油和调味料过早入锅容易焦。关火后用余温融化黄油，再加酱油增香；少许柠檬汁能平衡黄油的浓郁。

## 参考链接

bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Skin-on salmon, salt and cooking oil
- Butter
- A few drops of soy sauce and lemon juice, optional
- Bonus serving: cooked salmon, rice and soy-milk miso sauce

## Method

### 1. Dry the salmon

Pat the flesh and skin dry with paper towels before cooking.

### 2. Salt ahead

Salt 10 minutes before cooking, then blot away the released moisture. Optionally make 1–2 shallow cuts in the skin; do not cut deeply.

### 3. Preheat and oil the pan

Preheat the frying pan, then add oil and coat the cooking surface.

### 4. Start skin-side down

Place the salmon skin-side down over medium heat. Press gently at first if the skin lifts, then release once it holds its shape.

### 5. Wait before turning

Leave the fish undisturbed until the skin sets, browns and releases naturally. Turn and continue cooking gently until cooked through. 

### 6. Finish off the heat

Once cooked, turn off the heat and melt butter with residual heat. Optionally add a few drops of soy sauce and spoon the butter sauce over the fish. Finish with a little lemon juice if desired.

### 7. Bonus: salmon rice bowl

Flake the cooked salmon over rice and serve with soy-milk miso sauce.

## Tips

- Dry the fish and blot away moisture released after salting to reduce unwanted odor and improve browning. Surface water interferes with searing.
- Salting ahead gives seasoning time to penetrate and draws out excess moisture. Salting just before cooking tends to leave seasoning on the surface.
- Shallow skin cuts help limit shrinkage and improve contact with the pan. Deep cuts let fat escape; scoring is optional.
- Preheating and coating the pan with oil help reduce sticking. Start skin-on fish on its skin side, gently pressing lifted areas only until the skin sets.
- Moving the fish before its surface sets can make it stick and tear. Wait for natural release before turning. Skinless fish should also be left until its surface sets.
- High heat or prolonged cooking drives out moisture and fat, leaving dry flesh. Use gentle medium heat and watch both browning and doneness.
- Butter and seasonings can burn if added too early. Melt butter off the heat, then add soy sauce for aroma; a little lemon balances the richness.

title: 脆嫩西兰花与两种风味

descriptionEn: Briefly blanch, chill and drain, then choose garlic-seared or miso-cheese broccoli.
body:
## 食材

- 西兰花（花球和去皮茎部均可使用）
- 焯水用盐 1 茶匙
- 冰水
- 蒜香版：橄榄油、大蒜、盐、少许酱油、黑胡椒
- 味噌芝士版：少量味噌、红黄甜椒、小块芝士、橄榄油

## 做法

### 1. 倒置浸洗

花球朝下放入一盆清水，轻轻转动，洗去花蕾间的杂质。也可覆盖厨房纸短暂浸泡。

### 2. 分成均匀小朵

在分枝的茎部下刀，再用手掰开，尽量保持大小均匀。较硬外皮可薄削；主茎修去底部硬端，削皮后切块一起使用。

### 3. 短时盐水焯煮

水烧开后加盐 1 茶匙，放入西兰花，焯 40～60 秒，观察颜色转为鲜绿。

### 4. 立即冷却并沥干

捞出后立即放入冰水，停止余热继续加热。再捞出摊放在滤篮里，充分沥去水分，避免后续调味被稀释。

### 5. 蒜香版：煎出香气

锅中加橄榄油和大蒜，缓慢加热出香。先让西兰花茎部接触锅面，用中火至中大火煎至表面微微上色。撒盐，沿锅边加少许酱油，关火后撒黑胡椒。

### 6. 味噌芝士版：烤香

在焯好、沥干的西兰花上薄薄抹少量味噌，搭配红黄甜椒。放入烤箱烤约 2～3 分钟至表面略上色、出香。

### 7. 加芝士收尾

放上小块芝士，用烹饪喷枪轻炙至金黄，最后淋少许橄榄油。

## 小贴士

- 花蕾缝隙容易藏杂质，只在水龙头下快速冲洗不够彻底。花球倒置浸水、轻轻转动，有助于洗出里面的杂质。
- 小朵大小不均，会出现小块过熟、大块仍硬的情况。先切茎再手掰，既能控制大小，也能保留自然形状。
- 茎部也能吃：去掉硬底和粗皮，能减少纤维感，吃到与花球不同的甜味和口感。
- 盐水短焯能衬出甜味。长时间猛煮会让西兰花颜色暗淡、口感水软，苦味更明显；水溶性营养也会进入煮水。
- 焯好后放着不管，余热会继续加热。立即冰水降温，再充分沥干，能保留脆嫩口感，也避免表面水分稀释调味。
- 蒜香版先缓慢煸出蒜香，再让西兰花表面略微上色；锅边少许酱油能增加烘烤般的香气，黑胡椒关火后加入以保留香气。
- 味噌薄抹即可，搭配芝士的咸香和橄榄油的丰润；红黄甜椒能增加色彩与口感。
- 基础处理完成后，选择蒜香或味噌芝士其中一种。蒸制也是另一种处理方式，可保留西兰花的甜味。

bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Broccoli (florets and peeled stalk)
- 1 teaspoon salt for blanching
- Ice water
- Garlic version: olive oil, garlic, salt, a little soy sauce and black pepper
- Miso-cheese version: a little miso, red and yellow bell peppers, small pieces of cheese and olive oil

## Method

### 1. Wash upside down

Submerge the florets upside down in a bowl of water and swirl gently to loosen trapped debris. You can also cover with paper towels for a brief soak.

### 2. Cut evenly

Score the branching stems and separate by hand into similar-sized florets. Lightly peel tough outer layers. Trim the tough end of the main stalk, peel and cut it for cooking too.

### 3. Blanch briefly

Bring water to a boil and add 1 teaspoon salt. Blanch the broccoli for 40–60 seconds, watching for a vibrant green color. 

### 4. Chill and drain

Transfer immediately to ice water to stop residual cooking. Drain and spread out in a colander to remove excess moisture before seasoning.

### 5. Garlic version: sear

Slowly heat olive oil and garlic in a pan until fragrant. Start with the broccoli stems against the pan and sear over medium to medium-high heat until lightly browned. Season with salt, add a little soy sauce around the pan edge, then turn off the heat and finish with black pepper.

### 6. Miso-cheese version: grill

Spread a little miso thinly over the blanched, drained broccoli and add red and yellow bell peppers. Grill in the oven for about 2–3 minutes until fragrant and lightly browned. 

### 7. Finish with cheese

Top with small pieces of cheese and lightly torch until golden. Finish with a little olive oil.

## Tips

- Debris can lodge between florets, so a quick rinse may not be enough. Submerge the crown upside down and swirl gently to loosen trapped particles.
- Uneven florets cook unevenly: smaller pieces soften before larger ones. Score the stems and separate by hand for similar sizes and a natural shape.
- The stalk is edible too. Trim the tough base and peel its coarse skin to reduce toughness and enjoy a different sweetness and texture from the florets.
- Brief salted blanching brings out sweetness. Prolonged vigorous boiling dulls the color, makes the texture watery and can intensify bitterness; water-soluble nutrients also enter the cooking water.
- Residual heat keeps cooking broccoli left standing after blanching. Chill immediately, then drain thoroughly to retain a crisp bite and avoid diluting the seasoning.
- For the garlic version, infuse the oil slowly before lightly browning the broccoli. A little soy sauce around the pan edge adds a roasted aroma; add black pepper off the heat to preserve its fragrance.
- Use a thin coating of miso with the savory cheese and richness of olive oil. Red and yellow bell peppers add color and texture.
- After the basic preparation, choose either the garlic or miso-cheese version. Steaming is another way to prepare broccoli while preserving its sweetness.

title: 冷锅脆皮鸡腿
description: 冷锅起煎，缓慢逼油；翻面一次，测温后静置再切。
descriptionEn: Start in a cold pan, render slowly, turn once and check the temperature before resting.
body:
## 食材

- 带皮去骨鸡腿 1 块，约 150 克（1 人份）
- 盐 1.2～1.5 克，约为鸡肉重量的 0.8～1%
- 橄榄油 20 克、大蒜 1/2 瓣：用于腌制
- 可选：黄油 5～10 克、少量酱油、柠檬 1 角、少量黑胡椒

## 做法

### 1. 修整并擦干

去除硬脂肪、筋和软骨，保留适量柔软脂肪。从肉面浅切较厚部位并展开，使厚度均匀，不要切穿鸡皮。两面擦干。

### 2. 盐渍与冷藏腌制

两面均匀撒盐，放入容器，加入橄榄油和大蒜拌匀。时间紧可腌约 30 分钟；条件允许时在冰箱腌 6 小时至隔夜。下锅前擦去两面多余水分和油。

### 3. 冷锅皮朝下

鸡皮朝下放进冷锅，再开中小火，主要利用鸡肉自身油脂煎制。若鸡肉偏瘦或锅易粘，可先薄涂一层油。

### 4. 轻压贴锅

开始的 30 秒至 1 分钟用锅铲轻压，特别留意中间翘起处。也可在肉面垫烘焙纸，加轻重物辅助贴锅；皮定形后移去重物和纸，不要把肉压扁。

### 5. 慢煎逼油，翻面一次

保持中小火，不急着移动。等鸡皮能自然脱锅、均匀金黄，肉的侧边变白后再翻面，并降低火力。以皮面约占总烹饪时间 80%、肉面约占 20% 作参考；翻面后不要再压肉。

### 6. 将熟时加黄油并测温

鸡肉接近熟透时，可在锅的空白处加黄油，倾斜锅，把融化黄油主要舀到肉面和侧边，减少浇到脆皮上。温度计从侧面插入，确认中心至少达到 74°C，再关火。

### 7. 关火调味与静置

按喜好在锅中黄油里加少量酱油和柠檬，黑胡椒可选。鸡皮朝上静置 3～5 分钟再切。想保持脆皮，将酱汁放在盘边；浇在皮上会降低酥脆感。

## 小贴士

- 包装里的渗出液会让鸡皮偏向蒸熟，也容易带来异味。修整后和腌制后都擦干，能帮助鸡皮煎得酥脆。
- 只去掉硬脂肪、筋和软骨，保留柔软脂肪增加风味。厚处从肉面展开，使整块厚薄接近，避免薄处已经过熟、厚处仍没熟。
- 橄榄油与大蒜腌制可以减轻鸡肉的特有气味，增加风味。
- 热锅下鸡腿，鸡皮容易迅速收缩、翘离锅面，造成上色不均。冷锅中小火起煎，让皮下脂肪慢慢析出，鸡皮逐渐变薄、变脆。
- 轻压是为了让鸡皮贴锅，不是把鸡肉压扁。皮定形后撤去压力，等自然脱锅再翻面，避免撕破鸡皮。
- 脆皮靠缓慢逼油，不是靠大火煎黑。频繁翻面和持续大火会让熟度更难控制；翻面后降低火力，也不要再压肉挤出汁水。
- 黄油等鸡肉接近熟透时再加，减少烧焦风险。主要浇肉面和侧边；酱汁直接浇皮会牺牲部分酥脆感，想保脆就放盘边。
- 表面金黄不代表中心熟透，应测量中心温度。出锅后皮朝上静置再切，让肉汁稳定，也有助于保持脆皮。

## 参考链接

- [YouTube · SAMUKICHI](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QG_bnywZR5w)
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- 1 boneless, skin-on chicken thigh, about 150 g (serves 1)
- 1.2–1.5 g salt, about 0.8–1% of the chicken weight
- 20 g olive oil and 1/2 clove garlic for marinating
- Optional: 5–10 g butter, a little soy sauce, 1 lemon wedge and a little black pepper

## Method

### 1. Trim and dry

Remove firm fat, sinew and cartilage while retaining some soft fat. Open the thick areas with shallow cuts from the meat side without cutting through the skin. Even out the thickness and pat both sides dry.

### 2. Season and marinate

Salt both sides evenly, place in a container and coat with the olive oil and garlic. Allow about 30 minutes if short on time; preferably marinate in the refrigerator for 6 hours to overnight. Wipe excess moisture and oil from both sides just before cooking.

### 3. Start in a cold pan

Place skin-side down in a cold pan, then turn on medium-low heat. Cook mainly in the rendered chicken fat; lightly oil the pan if the chicken is lean or the pan tends to stick.

### 4. Keep the skin in contact

Press gently with a spatula for the first 30 seconds to 1 minute, especially where the center lifts. Alternatively, place parchment on the meat side and use a light weight to maintain contact. Remove the weight and paper once the skin sets; do not crush the meat.

### 5. Render slowly and turn once

Keep medium-low heat and leave the chicken undisturbed until it releases naturally, the skin is evenly golden and the sides turn white. Flip once and lower the heat. As a guide, spend about 80% of cooking time on the skin side and 20% on the meat side. Do not press after turning.

### 6. Baste and check doneness

When nearly cooked, optionally melt butter in an empty part of the pan. Tilt the pan and spoon it mainly over the flesh and edges to preserve the crispy skin. Insert a thermometer from the side and ensure the center reaches at least 74°C before turning off the heat.

### 7. Season and rest

Off the heat, optionally add a little soy sauce and lemon to the pan butter, with black pepper if desired. Rest skin-side up for 3–5 minutes before cutting. Serve the sauce beside the chicken to keep the skin crisp; pouring it over the skin softens it.

## Tips

- Package juices can steam the skin and contribute unwanted odor. Drying after trimming and again after marinating helps the skin crisp.
- Remove firm fat, sinew and cartilage but keep soft fat for flavor. Open thick areas from the flesh side to even the thickness, so thin areas do not overcook while thick areas remain underdone.
- Marinating in olive oil and garlic reduces the characteristic chicken odor and adds flavor.
- A hot pan can make the skin contract and lift, causing uneven browning. Starting cold over medium-low heat slowly renders the fat underneath, thinning and crisping the skin.
- Gentle pressure keeps the skin against the pan; it should not flatten the meat. Release the pressure once the skin sets and wait for natural release before turning to avoid tearing.
- Crispness comes from slowly rendering fat, not scorching over high heat. Repeated flipping and sustained high heat make doneness harder to control. Lower the heat after turning and do not press out the juices.
- Add butter only when the chicken is nearly cooked to reduce burning. Baste mainly the flesh and edges. Sauce softens crispy skin; serve it beside the chicken to preserve the crunch.
- Golden skin does not prove the center is cooked; measure the internal temperature. Rest skin-side up before cutting to let the juices settle and keep the skin crisp.

title: 香煎芦笋与五花肉卷
description: 根部削皮，中火煎后短蒸；附巴萨米克醋五花肉卷。
descriptionEn: Peel the base, sear over medium heat and briefly steam; includes balsamic pork rolls.
body:
## 食材

- 基础版：芦笋、食用油、盐、少量水、少许酱油、黄油
- 肉卷版（1～2 人份）：芦笋 3 根、五花肉薄片 3 片（约 60～80 克）
- 肉卷版：蒜油 1～2 汤匙、巴萨米克醋 3～5 汤匙、盐与黑胡椒适量
- 肉卷版：黄油 5 克，可选

## 做法

### 1. 削去根部硬皮

清洗芦笋，用削皮器只处理根部粗硬外皮，保留嫩芯，不需整根削皮或固定切去很长一段。

### 2. 基础版：斜切、擦干

芦笋斜切，扩大切面，再用厨房纸充分吸干表面水分。锅中加油并预热后再下芦笋。

### 3. 中火翻煎

中火煎制并间歇滚动，让各面均匀受热。略能弯曲而仍有挺度时准备收尾，不要煎至软塌。

### 4. 少量水短蒸

最后调味前加少量水，短蒸约 10 秒，帮助中心受热。

### 5. 最后调味、关火拌黄油

最后撒盐。少许酱油先接触热锅面，再与芦笋拌匀。关火后加黄油，用余温融化并拌匀。

### 6. 肉卷版：先缠肉再切段

另取处理好、擦干的整根芦笋，紧紧缠上五花肉薄片，再切成一口大小。此做法从处理后的生芦笋开始，不需先完成基础版煎制。

### 7. 蒜油中火煎肉卷

锅中加热蒜油至出香，放入肉卷，中火间歇滚动，煎至各面均匀金黄、猪肉熟透、芦笋中心受热。

### 8. 加醋收汁，关火撒黑胡椒

加入巴萨米克醋，边翻动边略微收汁，使酱汁均匀裹住肉卷。关火后撒黑胡椒，装盘并淋上锅中剩余酱汁。

## 小贴士

- 根部粗硬的是外层纤维，削去硬皮即可保留里面可吃的嫩芯。整根削皮或直接切掉很长一段，会损失风味或浪费食材。
- 斜切增加切面，也切断部分较硬纤维，有助于热量进入中心。切成普通等长段，尖端和粗根的熟度容易不同。
- 湿芦笋下锅容易变成蒸煮，冷锅下菜则容易在煎香前先出水。表面擦干、油预热后下锅，更容易煎出香气。
- 大火急煎容易外焦内硬。中火并间歇滚动，让热量均匀传到中心；不要一直煎到软塌，略能弯曲时就准备收尾，兼顾余热。
- 短蒸让中心继续受热，也让颜色更鲜亮；先煎后短蒸，兼顾煎香与脆嫩。
- 盐最后加，保留内部口感。酱油先碰热锅面再拌菜，能增加焦香；黄油容易焦，关火后用余温融化。
- 基础版与肉卷版分别从生芦笋开始，选择其一。肉卷先紧缠五花肉再切段，煎时肉脂能为芦笋增香。
- 肉卷中火滚动煎制，兼顾五花肉上色与芦笋中心受热；巴萨米克醋平衡油脂的浓郁感，略微收汁后能均匀挂在肉卷表面。

## Ingredients

- Basic version: asparagus, cooking oil, salt, a splash of water, a little soy sauce and butter
- Pork rolls (serves 1–2): 3 asparagus spears and 3 thin pork belly slices (about 60–80 g)
- Pork rolls: 1–2 tablespoons garlic oil, 3–5 tablespoons balsamic vinegar, salt and black pepper to taste
- Pork rolls: 5 g butter, optional

## Method

### 1. Peel the tough base

Wash the asparagus and peel only the tough outer layer at the base, retaining the tender core. Do not peel the entire spear or routinely discard a long section.

### 2. Basic version: cut and dry

Cut diagonally to expose a larger surface, then pat thoroughly dry with paper towels. Heat oil in the pan before adding the asparagus.

### 3. Sear over medium heat

Sear over medium heat, rolling occasionally for even cooking. Finish while slightly flexible but still firm rather than limp. 

### 4. Steam briefly

Before seasoning, add a splash of water and steam for about 10 seconds to help cook the center. 

### 5. Season and finish off the heat

Salt at the end. Let a little soy sauce contact the hot pan before tossing with the asparagus. Turn off the heat, add butter and toss as it melts in the residual heat.

### 6. Pork rolls: wrap before cutting

Start with separate, prepped and dried whole asparagus spears. Wrap tightly in thin pork belly slices, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Use the prepared raw spears rather than completing the basic searing method first.

### 7. Sear the rolls in garlic oil

Heat garlic oil until fragrant. Add the rolls and sear over medium heat, turning occasionally until evenly golden, the pork is cooked through and the asparagus center is heated. 

### 8. Glaze and finish

Add balsamic vinegar and reduce slightly while tossing to coat the rolls. Turn off the heat, add black pepper, plate and drizzle over the remaining pan sauce.

## Tips

- The tough fibers are concentrated in the outer layer at the base. Peel them to retain the edible core. Peeling the whole spear weakens flavor, while discarding a long base wastes edible asparagus.
- Diagonal cuts expose more surface and cut through some tough fibers, helping heat reach the center. Ordinary equal-length chunks can leave the tips and thick bases cooking at different rates.
- Wet asparagus steams instead of browning; a cold pan lets moisture escape before searing. Dry the surface and preheat the oil for better aroma.
- High heat can scorch the outside while leaving a tough center. Use medium heat and roll occasionally for even cooking. Finish while slightly flexible rather than limp, allowing for residual heat.
- A brief steam helps heat the center and brightens the color. Searing first and steaming briefly combines aroma with a crisp-tender bite.
- Salt at the end to retain the internal texture. Let soy sauce contact the hot pan before tossing for a toasted aroma. Butter burns easily, so melt it with residual heat after turning off the heat.
- The basic version and rolls are separate preparations, each starting with raw asparagus. Wrap the pork tightly before cutting; its rendered fat flavors the asparagus.
- Sear the rolls over medium heat, turning for even pork browning and heat through the asparagus. Balsamic vinegar balances the rich fat; a slight reduction helps the glaze coat the rolls.

title: 焦香烤花椰菜与奶酪变化
titleEn: Deeply browned roasted cauliflower with a cheese variation
description: 擦干、薄油、切面贴盘，烤出深褐色焦面与柔嫩内里。
descriptionEn: Dry thoroughly, coat lightly with oil and roast flat-side down for deep browning and a tender center.
body:
## 食材

- 花椰菜 300 克（1～2 人份）
- 蒜油或橄榄油，薄薄裹住表面的量
- 盐约 2.2 克
- 黑胡椒适量
- 柠檬少许
- 可选奶酪变化：马苏里拉奶酪、帕玛森奶酪、橄榄油

## 做法

### 1. 分切并洗净

去掉外层叶子，把花椰菜分成小朵。大朵对半切开，做出能贴住烤盘的平整面；小朵可以保持整朵。放入清水轻轻清洗，水变浑就换水，重复几次。

### 2. 擦干并调味

彻底擦干花椰菜，连小朵缝隙间的水也要去掉。拌入蒜油或橄榄油，让表面微微发亮即可，再拌入盐。300 克花椰菜用约 2.2 克盐作为参考。

### 3. 留空隙摆盘

花椰菜单层排在烤盘上，彼此留足空隙，不要重叠。大朵切出的平整面朝下，紧贴烤盘。

### 4. 充分预热后烤制

将烤箱充分预热至 220°C（425°F），再放入烤盘。先烤 12 分钟，期间不要翻动，让切面形成深褐色焦面。时间按烤箱和花朵大小调整；这里使用家用对流烤箱。

### 5. 检查颜色再翻面

检查贴盘的切面。颜色仍浅就先不翻，每次再烤 1～2 分钟。切面呈深褐色后，只翻一次面，再烤约 5 分钟。完成时切面有浓郁焦色，花蕾边缘也有烘烤色泽，内部柔嫩。搭配黑胡椒和少许柠檬享用。

### 6. 可选奶酪变化

这一步是在基础烤花椰菜完成后再做的变化。铺上马苏里拉奶酪，撒上帕玛森奶酪，淋少许橄榄油，再用上火炙烤至奶酪融化。

## 小贴士

- 大朵整个烤，贴盘面积小，容易仍然发白。切出平整面并朝下摆放，才能增加直接接触烤盘的面积。
- 带水入炉或摆得太挤，水分会变成蒸汽，花椰菜更像蒸熟，难以烤出焦色。擦干、留间隙与充分预热要一起做好。
- 不放油容易表面干却不上色；薄薄一层油有助于传热，不需要大量浸油。
- 不要为检查而频繁翻动。先等切面上色，再翻一次；烤箱和花朵大小不同，颜色比机械照搬时间更有用。

## 参考链接

- [观看原视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_ki3H1gioig)

## Ingredients

- Cauliflower, 300 g (serves 1–2)
- Garlic oil or olive oil, enough to lightly coat
- Salt, about 2.2 g
- Black pepper, to taste
- A little lemon
- Optional cheese variation: mozzarella, Parmesan and olive oil

## Method

### 1. Cut and wash

Remove the outer leaves and separate the cauliflower into florets. Halve large florets to create a flat surface that can sit against the tray; small florets can remain whole. Wash gently in a bowl of water, changing dirty water and repeating a few times.

### 2. Dry and season

Dry thoroughly, including moisture trapped between the florets. Toss with garlic oil or olive oil until the surface has a light sheen, then add the salt. About 2.2 g of salt for 300 g of cauliflower is a useful guideline.

### 3. Arrange with space

Arrange in a single layer with plenty of space between florets, without overlapping. Place the flat cut sides firmly against the tray.

### 4. Roast in a fully heated oven

Fully preheat the oven to 220°C (425°F) before inserting the tray. Roast for 12 minutes without turning so the flat sides can develop deep browning. Adjust for your oven and floret size; the demonstration uses a home convection oven.

### 5. Check the color before turning

Check the side touching the tray. If it is still pale, leave it unturned and roast for another 1–2 minutes at a time. Once deeply browned, turn just once and roast for about 5 minutes more. The finished cauliflower should have deeply browned cut surfaces, roasted color around the floret edges and a tender center. Serve with black pepper and a little lemon.

### 6. Optional cheese variation

This is a separate finish for the completed basic roast. Top with mozzarella, sprinkle with Parmesan and drizzle with a little olive oil, then broil until the cheese melts.

## Tips

- Large whole florets have little tray contact and can remain pale. Creating a flat side and placing it downward increases direct contact with the tray.
- Wet or crowded florets trap steam and cook more like steamed vegetables. Drying, spacing and fully preheating work together to support browning.
- Roasting without oil can dry the surface without good browning. A thin coating helps transfer heat; the florets do not need to soak in oil.
- Avoid frequent turning to check progress. Brown the cut side before turning once; oven differences and floret size make color a better guide than following the clock alone.

title: 焦香猪肉蔬菜炒面
description: 面条先单独煎香，猪肉蔬菜依次炒熟，水分收干后再裹酱。
descriptionEn: Brown the noodles separately, cook pork and vegetables in order, then sauce after excess moisture evaporates.
body:
## 食材

- 日式蒸炒面 150 克（1 人份）
- 薄切猪肩肉 70 克
- 卷心菜 70 克
- 洋葱 30 克
- 胡萝卜 20 克
- 食用油适量
- 葱花少许
- 水少许，粘锅时按需使用
- 酱汁：日式伍斯特酱 30 毫升、蚝油 10 毫升、番茄酱 10 毫升、酱油 5 毫升、糖约 4 克

## 做法

### 1. 温热并松开面条

用微波炉或蒸笼将日式蒸炒面稍微加热，再轻轻抖散，不要硬拉冷藏结块的面条。具体加热和预处理依包装说明；若改用鲜炒面或鲜拉面，按包装处理并充分沥干。150 克指日式蒸炒面的重量。

### 2. 调好酱汁

混合日式伍斯特酱、蚝油、番茄酱、酱油和糖，搅拌均匀。若用西式伍斯特酱，其酸味可能更突出、甜味更低，先用少于 30 毫升的量，再少量多次调整。也可用市售日式炒面酱，按味道浓淡调整用量。

### 3. 预热锅并单独煎面

用中火左右预热炒锅，按锅的材质调整，锅面涂一层薄油。放入松开的面条，铺在锅底，先单独煎，不加肉和蔬菜。静置至部分面条形成焦斑再翻动，不必把所有面条都煎脆，里面应保持筋道。快要焦黑就减火；若牢牢粘锅，要移动处理，不要一直干等。煎好先盛出。

### 4. 依次炒肉和蔬菜

按需另加适量油，用中火先炒猪肉。猪肉熟透后加入洋葱和胡萝卜，最后加入卷心菜，快速炒至食材熟且卷心菜仍有爽脆感。一次做得多就分批炒，避免锅内积水。

### 5. 回锅并收干多余水分

将面条倒回锅中混合。若开始粘锅，可加极少量水帮助松开，但不要倒很多水。让锅内多余水分先蒸发，再加酱汁。

### 6. 降火拌酱

酱汁容易焦，加入前先稍微减火，再倒入调好的酱汁，快速翻拌至均匀裹住面条。尝味调整，撒葱花出锅。成品面条应有焦香、表面裹酱发亮，能根根挑起，而不是软烂结成沉重团块。

## 小贴士

- 冷面直接强行掰开容易断成短段；先温热再轻轻松开。
- 锅没热透或没有薄油膜就下面，更容易粘锅。煎面与炒配料分别按需用油。
- 一开始把面和蔬菜一起炒，蔬菜水分会把面蒸软；不停翻动又缩短贴锅时间，两者都不利于焦香。
- 猪肉与蔬菜熟得快慢不同。先肉，再洋葱胡萝卜，最后卷心菜，便于控制熟度与口感。
- 锅里还有水就加酱，面条容易吸进过多水分而软烂。少量水只用于必要时松锅，随后仍要收干多余水分。
- 日式伍斯特酱与西式版本并不等味，不要不加调整地按同一用量替换。

## Ingredients

- Japanese steamed yakisoba noodles, 150 g (serves 1)
- Thinly sliced pork shoulder, 70 g
- Cabbage, 70 g
- Onion, 30 g
- Carrot, 20 g
- Cooking oil, as needed
- A little chopped green onion
- A little water, only if needed for sticking
- Sauce: Japanese Worcestershire sauce, 30 ml; oyster sauce, 10 ml; ketchup, 10 ml; soy sauce, 5 ml; sugar, about 4 g

## Method

### 1. Warm and loosen the noodles

Lightly warm the steamed yakisoba noodles in a microwave or steamer, then gently loosen them. Do not force apart cold, clumped noodles. Follow the package directions for warming and preparation. If using fresh chow mein or fresh ramen noodles, prepare according to the package and drain thoroughly. The 150 g refers to steamed yakisoba noodles.

### 2. Mix the sauce

Combine the Japanese Worcestershire sauce, oyster sauce, ketchup, soy sauce and sugar. Western Worcestershire sauce may be sharper and less sweet, so start with less than 30 ml and adjust a little at a time. Store-bought Japanese yakisoba sauce also works; adjust the quantity to its strength.

### 3. Heat the wok and brown the noodles separately

Preheat the wok over roughly medium heat, adjusting for its material, and coat with a thin layer of oil. Add the loosened noodles and spread across the bottom without the meat or vegetables. Leave undisturbed until some noodles develop browned spots, then turn. They do not all need to become crisp; keep the interior chewy. Lower the heat if they threaten to burn; move noodles that stick firmly instead of simply waiting. Remove the browned noodles.

### 4. Cook the pork and vegetables in order

Add more oil as needed and stir-fry the pork over medium heat. Once cooked through, add the onion and carrot. Add cabbage last and stir-fry briefly until the ingredients are cooked while the cabbage retains some crunch. Cook larger quantities in batches to avoid excess liquid collecting in the wok.

### 5. Return the noodles and evaporate moisture

Return the noodles and combine. If they begin sticking, use a tiny splash of water to loosen them, without adding a lot. Let excess moisture evaporate before adding the sauce.

### 6. Lower the heat and add sauce

The sauce burns easily, so reduce the heat slightly before adding it. Toss quickly to coat the noodles evenly. Taste, adjust the seasoning and finish with chopped green onion. The noodles should be toasty and glossy with sauce, lifting in separate strands rather than falling in heavy, soggy clumps.

## Tips

- Forcing cold noodles apart can break them into short pieces. Warm first, then loosen gently.
- Adding noodles before the wok is heated and thinly oiled encourages sticking. Use oil separately as needed for the noodles and other ingredients.
- Vegetables cooked with noodles from the start release moisture that steams them. Constant stirring also reduces contact with the wok; both interfere with browning.
- Pork and vegetables cook at different speeds. Start with pork, follow with onion and carrot, and add cabbage last to control doneness and texture.
- Adding sauce while water remains can make noodles absorb excess moisture and become soggy. Use a little water only when needed to loosen sticking, then evaporate the excess.
- Japanese and Western Worcestershire sauces have different flavors; adjust rather than replacing them in equal amounts without tasting.

title: 蒜香黄油酱油煎蘑菇
titleEn: Golden mushrooms with garlic, butter and soy
description: 先用少量水逼出蘑菇水分，收干后再加油煎香，最后低火融入蒜香黄油。
descriptionEn: Release moisture with a little water, evaporate it before browning in oil, then finish gently with garlic butter.
body:
## 食材

- 大白蘑菇 3 个（1～2 人份）
- 水 10 毫升
- 黄油 10 克
- 大蒜 1 瓣，切碎
- 酱油 5 克
- 橄榄油少许
- 盐少许
- 柠檬汁少许
- 黑胡椒适量

## 做法

### 1. 快洗擦干并厚切

蘑菇快速用水冲洗去掉表面污垢，不要长时间浸泡。只有少量污垢时，可用湿厨房纸擦净。洗后用厨房纸彻底吸干表面水分，切成四等份，保留厚度，让煎好的蘑菇仍然饱满。

### 2. 不放油，先加少量水

将蘑菇放进没有加油的锅中，加入 10 毫升水，用大火加热，让蘑菇逐渐释放自身的水分。

### 3. 收干水分后加油

继续加热，让锅内水分蒸发。观察水分几乎消失、声音由微沸声变成滋滋声；水分收干后，加少许橄榄油，调至中大火。

### 4. 静置煎至金黄

把蘑菇摊开，静置一会儿不要不停翻炒。贴锅面煎成深金黄色后再翻面，待两面都煎好，再撒少许盐。

### 5. 降火融入蒜香黄油

调至中小火，把蘑菇移到锅的上侧并倾斜锅身。在下侧空处加入黄油和大蒜，让蒜浸在融化的黄油中缓缓出香。闻到香气后，翻拌使所有蘑菇裹上蒜香黄油。

### 6. 酱油碰热锅，关火收尾

将 5 克酱油加在锅的热表面，让它短暂滋滋响，再翻拌裹匀蘑菇。香气裹匀后关火，装盘挤上少许柠檬汁，撒黑胡椒。成品外表金黄、内部饱满多汁。

## 小贴士

- 快洗后擦干，与下锅时加少量水是不同阶段：前者去掉多余表面水，后者启动出水过程；关键是先出水并收干，再煎上色。
- 一开始加很多油，蘑菇容易吸油，结果用油过多。锅里还有水就加油，也难以进入良好的上色阶段。
- 不停翻炒会缩短蘑菇与锅面的接触时间，难以煎出深金黄色。先摊开静置，上色后再翻。
- 蒜和黄油用于最后增香，不用于前期长时间上色。太早加入，蒜容易焦、黄油香气也容易流失；先煎好蘑菇，再降低火力加入。
- 酱油先接触热锅表面，短暂受热出香后再拌匀；柠檬与黑胡椒在装盘后加入，用酸度和香气平衡黄油的浓郁。

## 参考链接

- [观看原视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6Aa3aFccue8)
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Large white button mushrooms, 3 (serves 1–2)
- Water, 10 ml
- Butter, 10 g
- Garlic, 1 clove, chopped
- Soy sauce, 5 g
- A little olive oil
- A little salt
- A little lemon juice
- Black pepper, to taste

## Method

### 1. Wash briefly, dry and cut thickly

Quickly wash the mushrooms to remove surface dirt without soaking for a long time. If only lightly dirty, wipe with a damp paper towel instead. Pat the surface thoroughly dry and cut into quarters, keeping the pieces thick so they remain plump after cooking.

### 2. Start with a little water and no oil

Put the mushrooms in a pan without oil. Add 10 ml water and cook over high heat, allowing them to gradually release their own moisture.

### 3. Evaporate the moisture before adding oil

Continue heating to evaporate the liquid. Watch for moisture almost disappearing and the sound changing from simmering to sizzling. Once the liquid has cooked off, add a little olive oil and reduce to medium-high heat.

### 4. Leave to brown

Spread out the mushrooms and leave undisturbed rather than stirring constantly. Turn once the contact surface is deeply golden. When both sides are well browned, season lightly with salt.

### 5. Lower the heat and infuse garlic butter

Reduce to medium-low heat. Move the mushrooms to the upper side of the pan and tilt it. Add the butter and garlic in the lower exposed area, allowing the garlic to infuse the melted butter gently. Once fragrant, toss to coat all the mushrooms.

### 6. Sizzle the soy sauce and finish off the heat

Add 5 g soy sauce to the hot pan surface, let it sizzle briefly, then toss with the mushrooms. Once coated with the aroma, turn off the heat. Plate, squeeze over a little lemon juice and finish with black pepper. The mushrooms should be golden outside and plump and juicy inside.

## Tips

- Drying after a quick wash and adding a little water in the pan serve different stages: the first removes excess surface water, while the second starts moisture release. Release moisture, cook it off and only then brown.
- A large amount of oil at the start can be absorbed, leading to excess oil use. Adding oil while liquid remains also makes good browning harder.
- Constant stirring reduces contact with the pan and prevents deep golden browning. Spread out, leave undisturbed and turn after browning.
- Garlic and butter add finishing aroma rather than doing the prolonged browning. Added too early, garlic can burn and butter can lose its fragrance. Brown the mushrooms first, then lower the heat before adding them.
- Let soy sauce briefly contact the hot pan for aroma before tossing. Lemon and black pepper go on after plating to brighten and balance the rich butter.

## References

title: 金枪鱼罐头三吃：嫩蛋、番茄吐司与酱油炒饭
titleEn: Canned tuna three ways: soft eggs, tomato toast and soy sauce fried rice
description: 保留适量罐头油、控制加入时机，用酸味平衡蛋黄酱，做三种各自独立的金枪鱼料理。
descriptionEn: Retain some packing oil, add tuna late and balance mayonnaise with acidity in three independent preparations.
body:
## 做法

### 1. 金枪鱼嫩蛋

食材（1 人份）：金枪鱼罐头 30 克、鸡蛋 2 个、蛋黄酱 10 克、黄油 5 克、食用油、黑胡椒。可搭配番茄酱和四季豆。

鸡蛋与蛋黄酱打匀。锅中加油，轻轻加热，倒入蛋液，用小火轻轻搅拌。蛋液半凝固时才加入金枪鱼，轻轻拌合。最后加入黄油拌匀，撒黑胡椒，保持鸡蛋柔软、略带流动感时出锅。可配番茄酱和四季豆。

### 2. 金枪鱼番茄蒜香吐司

食材（1 人份）：面包 1 片、金枪鱼罐头 20 克、番茄薄片 6 片（约中等番茄 1/2 个）、蛋黄酱 10 克、磨碎大蒜 1/3 瓣、少许柠檬汁、盐；另用大蒜擦面包。

番茄薄片撒少许盐，用厨房纸吸去析出的水分。面包先烤香，再用大蒜擦表面。蛋黄酱、磨碎的大蒜和少许柠檬汁拌成蒜香蛋黄酱。将沥去水分的番茄铺在面包上，放金枪鱼，淋蒜香蛋黄酱。最后放入烤箱稍烤，让各层风味融合。

### 3. 金枪鱼酱油炒饭

食材（1 人份）：煮熟并冷却的米饭 200 克、油浸金枪鱼罐头 1 罐（70 克，连油使用）、大蒜 1 瓣、少量酱油、葱花、黑胡椒、食用油。米饭可用日本米、加州米或寿司米。

锅充分烧热后加油，下冷却的米饭，边炒边打散，交替煎香和翻拌。米饭散开后加入蒜末炒出香气，再加入金枪鱼及罐头油，迅速拌匀，避免长时间加热。沿热锅边淋少量酱油激发香气，最后撒黑胡椒和葱花。

## 小贴士

- 油浸金枪鱼不要过度沥油：留一点罐头油能保留醇厚感、香气和湿润口感；炒饭则连油使用。这条处理方式针对油浸罐头。
- 金枪鱼煮得太久会失水、干柴、碎散。嫩蛋若从一开始就和金枪鱼同煮，会出现鱼肉变干、鸡蛋变老；等蛋液半凝固再加入。
- 蛋黄酱单独调味容易厚重；少量柠檬汁或醋可使余味清爽。吐司用柠檬汁配合番茄酸味。
- 番茄带着过多水分直接铺上吐司，会稀释风味；先撒盐、吸水再组合。
- 冷藏金枪鱼太冷时，香气容易显得强烈厚重；制作时稍微回温，有助于风味柔和融合。

bodyEn:
## Method

### 1. Soft tuna eggs

Ingredients (1 serving): 30 g canned tuna, 2 eggs, 10 g mayonnaise, 5 g butter, cooking oil and black pepper. Optional accompaniments: ketchup and green beans.

Beat the eggs with the mayonnaise. Add oil to a pan and warm gently. Pour in the eggs and stir gently over low heat. Add the tuna only when the eggs are softly set, then fold gently. Finish by mixing in the butter and sprinkling with black pepper. Serve while the eggs remain soft and slightly runny, with ketchup and green beans if desired.

### 2. Tuna tomato garlic toast

Ingredients (1 serving): 1 slice bread, 20 g canned tuna, 6 thin tomato slices (about 1/2 medium tomato), 10 g mayonnaise, 1/3 clove grated garlic, a small squeeze of lemon juice and salt; additional garlic for rubbing the bread.

Lightly salt the tomato slices and blot away released moisture with paper towels. Toast the bread, then rub its surface with garlic. Mix the mayonnaise, grated garlic and a little lemon juice into garlic mayo. Arrange the drained tomatoes on the bread, add tuna and drizzle with garlic mayo. Finish with a brief bake in the oven to bring the flavors together.

### 3. Soy sauce tuna fried rice

Ingredients (1 serving): 200 g cooked, cooled rice, 1 can oil-packed tuna (70 g, including its oil), 1 clove garlic, a small splash of soy sauce, chopped green onion, black pepper and cooking oil. Japanese rice, Calrose or sushi rice works.

Heat the pan well and add oil. Add the cooled rice, breaking up clumps as you stir-fry, alternating searing and mixing. Once the rice is loose, add finely chopped garlic and cook until fragrant. Add the tuna with its packing oil and mix promptly without prolonged heating. Drizzle a little soy sauce around the hot pan edge to release its aroma. Finish with black pepper and green onion.

## Tips

- Do not drain oil-packed tuna excessively: retain some packing oil for richness, aroma and moist texture; use the oil in the fried rice. This advice applies to oil-packed tuna.
- Prolonged cooking makes tuna lose moisture and become dry and crumbly. Cooking it with eggs from the start dries the fish and toughens the eggs; add it when the eggs are softly set.
- Mayonnaise alone can taste heavy. A little lemon juice or vinegar lightens the aftertaste; the toast uses lemon together with tomato acidity.
- Watery tomato slices dilute the toast's flavor. Salt and blot them before assembling.
- Tuna straight from the refrigerator can have a strong, heavy aroma when very cold. Let it warm slightly during preparation to help the flavors blend gently.

title: 去虾线与蒜香黄油虾
titleEn: Deveining shrimp and garlic butter shrimp
description: 用牙签轻挑虾线，轻冲吸干，再以蒜油、黄油和酱油煎香。
descriptionEn: Lift out the vein with a toothpick, rinse and blot gently, then cook with garlic oil, butter and soy sauce.
body:
## 食材

- 虾
- 蒜油 15 克
- 辣椒片一小撮
- 盐、胡椒
- 少量白葡萄酒或清酒
- 黄油约 5 克
- 酱油约 10 克

## 做法

### 1. 判断是否去虾线

检查虾的大小和背部虾线。较大的虾应先去线；很小的虾虾线细，不必为了去线而弄坏虾身。

### 2. 轻挑虾线

先移除背部会扎手的尖壳。找到靠近头部第二、三节附近的缝隙，轻弯虾身，让缝隙张开。将牙签或竹签轻轻穿到虾线下方，向上挑起；手指辅助，沿垂直方向缓慢提起，让整条虾线取出，不要猛拽。

### 3. 轻冲并吸干

用流水轻轻冲净，立即放滤篮沥水，再用厨房纸轻拍吸干。不要长时间浸泡、揉搓，或加盐搓洗。

### 4. 蒜油煎虾

锅中加蒜油 15 克和一小撮辣椒片加热，放入处理好的虾，撒盐和胡椒。翻面继续煎，让虾受热均匀，再加少量白葡萄酒或清酒增香。

### 5. 黄油酱油收尾

加入黄油约 5 克，最后淋酱油约 10 克。虾煎熟后盛出，把锅中酱汁淋在虾上。

## 小贴士

- 徒手硬拽会使虾线断裂，也容易损伤虾肉；先弯身扩大缝隙，用工具轻挑，再缓缓上提。
- 叉子或齿间刷的背部也能辅助去线，但齿间刷背部容易滑，牙签或竹签更稳定、好控制。
- 大虾去线有助于减少异味和杂味；细小虾不必一律去线，以免损伤外形和口感。
- 久泡会让口感水淡，揉搓或加盐搓洗可能带走风味；轻冲、立即沥干、轻拍吸干即可。

bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Shrimp
- 15 g garlic oil
- A pinch of sliced chili pepper
- Salt and pepper
- A small splash of white wine or sake
- About 5 g butter
- About 10 g soy sauce

## Method

### 1. Check whether deveining is needed

Check the shrimp's size and the vein along its back. Devein larger shrimp; very small shrimp have fine veins, so avoid damaging their bodies merely to remove them.

### 2. Lift the vein gently

Remove sharp shell points along the back that could prick your fingers. Find a gap near the second or third segment behind the head and bend the shrimp gently to open it. Slide a toothpick or bamboo skewer under the vein and lift. Support it with your fingers and raise it slowly in a vertical direction to remove it in one piece, without tugging hard.

### 3. Rinse and blot

Rinse gently under running water, drain immediately in a colander and blot with paper towels. Avoid prolonged soaking, rubbing or scrubbing with salt.

### 4. Cook in garlic oil

Heat 15 g garlic oil with a pinch of sliced chili pepper. Add the prepared shrimp and season with salt and pepper. Turn and continue cooking so they heat evenly, then add a small splash of white wine or sake for aroma.

### 5. Finish with butter and soy sauce

Add about 5 g butter, then finish with about 10 g soy sauce. Once the shrimp are cooked, plate them and spoon the pan sauce over the top.

## Tips

- Pulling hard by hand can break the vein and damage the flesh. Bend the body to widen the gap, lift with a fine tool and raise the vein slowly.
- A fork or the back of an interdental brush can also help remove veins, though the brush back can slip; toothpicks or bamboo skewers are steadier and easier to control.
- Deveining larger shrimp helps reduce unwanted flavors. Very small shrimp need not always be deveined at the expense of their shape and texture.
- Long soaking makes shrimp watery; rubbing or salt-scrubbing can wash away flavor. Rinse gently, drain immediately and blot dry.

title: 深色焦糖洋葱与浓郁洋葱汤
titleEn: Deep caramelized onions and rich onion soup
description: 中低火慢炒、间歇翻拌，反复用少量水融回锅底焦香，再做洋葱汤。
descriptionEn: Cook over medium-low heat with pauses between stirring, deglaze browned bits and turn the deeply colored onions into soup.
body:
## 食材

焦糖洋葱：洋葱、橄榄油 5 毫升（1 茶匙）、盐一小撮、少量水。

洋葱汤（1 人份）：橄榄油 5 毫升、大蒜 1 瓣、水 400 毫升、鸡粉 5 克、用 1/2 个洋葱炒成的焦糖洋葱、盐。可选配熟鸡胸肉、芦笋和黑胡椒。

## 做法

### 1. 均匀切片

洋葱切成约 2～3 毫米厚的均匀薄片，减少厚薄不一造成的受热差异。

### 2. 中低火慢炒

锅调中低火，加入橄榄油 5 毫升（1 茶匙），下洋葱拌匀裹油。加一小撮盐，帮助水分释出。保持中低火，慢慢炒软。

### 3. 接触锅底再翻拌

让洋葱在锅底停留一会儿再翻拌，重复进行，不要一直搅动。约 10～15 分钟后开始变透明。

### 4. 少量加水融回焦褐物

锅底出现焦褐物时加入少量水，将其溶解、拌回洋葱。每次再次形成焦褐物就重复，避免烧黑。约 20～30 分钟后开始出现深焦糖色。

### 5. 炒至深色柔软

继续中低火炒至深焦糖色、柔软融合，约需 30～40 分钟；以颜色和质地为准，不要在浅棕色阶段就出锅。

### 6. 制作洋葱汤

大蒜切片，与汤用橄榄油一起小火慢慢加热，释放香气但不炒褐。加水和鸡粉，炖煮几分钟，让蒜香融入汤中，尝味后按需加盐。关火，再加入焦糖洋葱轻轻拌匀，用余温热透，保留口感和香气。撒黑胡椒，可配熟鸡胸肉和芦笋。

### 7. 分装备用

多做的焦糖洋葱装入可密封储存袋，摊成薄层并封好，方便取用所需的量，用于汤、咖喱和酱汁。冷藏 3～4 天，冷冻约 2～3 个月。

## 小贴士

- 大火会在水分充分蒸发、甜味发展前把表面烧焦，形成苦味；中低火和均匀薄片更容易控制。
- 不停搅拌会降低温度，让洋葱更难上色；间歇翻拌，使洋葱有时间接触锅底。
- 锅底棕褐色附着物能带来浓郁风味，应及时用少量水融回。烧黑发苦的残渣与正常焦褐物不同，应避免烧到这个阶段。
- 浅棕色仍不是这道深色焦糖洋葱的终点；深焦糖色、柔软融合才是完成信号。火候与洋葱用量会影响时间。做汤的洋葱可以保留少许口感。

## 参考链接

## Ingredients

Caramelized onions: onions, 5 ml olive oil (1 teaspoon), a pinch of salt and a little water.

Onion soup (1 serving): 5 ml olive oil, 1 clove garlic, 400 ml water, 5 g chicken bouillon powder, caramelized onions made from 1/2 onion and salt. Optional additions: cooked chicken breast, asparagus and black pepper.

## Method

### 1. Slice evenly

Slice onions evenly, about 2～3 mm thick, to reduce uneven cooking from differences in thickness.

### 2. Cook over medium-low heat

Set the pan over medium-low heat. Add 5 ml olive oil (1 teaspoon), add the onions and coat evenly. Add a pinch of salt to help draw out moisture, then cook slowly over medium-low heat.

### 3. Let the onions contact the pan

Let the onions cook against the pan for a while before stirring, repeating this cycle rather than stirring constantly. They begin to turn translucent after about 10～15 minutes.

### 4. Deglaze the browned bits

When browned bits form on the pan bottom, add a little water to loosen them and mix them back into the onions. Repeat as more browned bits develop, preventing them from burning. A deep caramelized color begins to develop after about 20～30 minutes.

### 5. Finish deep and soft

Continue over medium-low heat until deeply caramelized, soft and cohesive, about 30～40 minutes. Judge by color and texture rather than stopping at light brown.

### 6. Make onion soup

Slice the garlic and warm it slowly with the soup's olive oil over low heat until fragrant without browning. Add the water and bouillon powder and simmer for a few minutes to infuse the garlic aroma. Taste and add salt if needed. Turn off the heat, then gently mix in the caramelized onions. Warm them through with residual heat to preserve texture and aroma. Finish with black pepper; add cooked chicken breast and asparagus if desired.

### 7. Store a batch for later

Put extra caramelized onions in a resealable storage bag, flatten into a thin layer and seal. This makes it easy to take the amount needed for soups, curries and sauces. Refrigerate for 3～4 days or freeze for about 2～3 months.

## Tips

- High heat can burn the surface before moisture evaporates and sweetness develops, making it bitter. Medium-low heat and even slices give better control.
- Constant stirring lowers the temperature and makes browning harder. Pause between stirring so the onions have time against the pan.
- Browned pan deposits add rich flavor; dissolve them promptly with a little water. Blackened, bitter residues differ from properly browned bits so prevent the deposits from burning that far.
- Light brown is an intermediate stage for these deeply caramelized onions. A deep color and soft, cohesive texture signal completion; heat level and onion quantity affect the time. Onions intended for soup can retain a little texture.

title: 芥末奶油酱煎牛排
titleEn: Pan-seared steak with mustard cream sauce
description: 先煎出焦壳，再降火频繁翻面，以中心温度判断熟度，配锅底芥末奶油酱。
descriptionEn: Brown the crust, lower the heat and turn frequently, then check the center temperature and make a mustard cream pan sauce.
body:
## 食材

- 西冷牛排 1 块，约 250 克、厚 2.5～3 厘米
- 盐、食用油适量
- 无盐黄油约 5 克，用于煎牛排
- 白葡萄酒或水 30 ml
- 淡奶油 40 ml
- 全粒芥末 10 克
- 无盐黄油 5 克，用于酱汁
- 黑胡椒、盐适量；少量水用于调整酱汁

## 做法

### 1. 擦干并调味

用厨房纸彻底擦干牛排两面，下锅前均匀撒盐，轻轻揉匀。有时间也可提前撒盐，放在架上，不覆盖，冷藏至少 45 分钟；煎前仍检查表面，擦去多余水分。

### 2. 煎边缘和大面

预热锅，倒油润锅，加入约 5 克黄油。先立起牛排煎脂肪边，再略煎对侧边，接着煎两个大面。以中火为起点，按锅和肉的状态调整；第一面形成漂亮焦色、较容易脱锅后翻面，再煎另一面。黄油应呈香气浓郁的金棕色，若有焦糊味或大量烟，立即减小火力。

### 3. 降火加热中心

两面上色后转小火，约每 30～60 秒翻面，让中心逐渐受热。焦壳过深时暂时把锅移开火源。用食物温度计检查中心，中心至少达到 63°C 后取出，静置至少 3 分钟；不要把牛排留在关火后的热锅里。

### 4. 利用锅底制作酱汁

趁牛排静置，倒去锅里多余油脂，清除焦黑残渣，保留棕色焦香物。锅回小火，加入 30 ml 白葡萄酒或水，刮松锅底。用酒时收至约一半，使尖锐酒气变柔和。加入 40 ml 淡奶油，小火慢慢收稠。

### 5. 关火拌入芥末和黄油

关火，拌入 10 克全粒芥末和 5 克黄油。加黑胡椒，尝味后按需补盐。太稠或味道过重时加少量水调整。牛排静置完成后切开，配酱汁装盘。

## 小贴士

- 湿表面先消耗热量蒸发水分，拖慢上色。火太小也会让上色耗时过长，中心反而容易过熟；焦壳形成后仍维持原火力，则容易把外层煎老。上色与加热中心应分开控制。
- 视频的口感参考为三分熟约 57°C、五分熟约 63°C、全熟约 71°C；这些是熟度描述。美国农业部的整块牛排安全建议是中心至少 63°C，并静置至少 3 分钟，较低的口感目标不等于达到这项建议。颜色、手感和焦壳不能替代温度计。
- 这份做法在起煎时用少量黄油增香，需留意焦化；酱汁的黄油则在关火后拌入，两个阶段不能混为同一种加油时机。
- 出锅静置能避免热锅继续猛烈加热；不要为了静置又把肉留在原锅中。

## 参考链接

## Ingredients

- 1 sirloin steak, about 250 g and 2.5～3 cm thick
- Salt and cooking oil as needed
- About 5 g unsalted butter for the steak
- 30 ml white wine or water
- 40 ml heavy cream
- 10 g whole-grain mustard
- 5 g unsalted butter for the sauce
- Black pepper and salt to taste; a little water to adjust the sauce

## Method

### 1. Dry and season

Thoroughly pat both sides dry with paper towels. Salt evenly just before cooking and rub it in gently. Alternatively, salt ahead, place on a rack uncovered and refrigerate for at least 45 minutes. Check the surface before cooking and remove excess moisture.

### 2. Brown the edges and broad sides

Preheat the pan, coat with oil and add about 5 g butter. Hold the steak upright to brown the fatty edge, briefly sear the opposite edge, then cook the broad sides. Start around medium heat and adjust to the pan and meat. Turn when the first side is nicely browned and releases relatively easily, then brown the other side. The butter should be fragrant and golden brown; reduce the heat immediately if it smells burnt or produces heavy smoke.

### 3. Lower the heat to cook the center

Once both sides are browned, lower the heat and turn roughly every 30～60 seconds to warm the center gradually. Briefly remove the pan from the heat if the crust gets too dark. Check the center with a food thermometer; remove when it reaches at least 63°C and rest for at least 3 minutes. Do not leave the steak in the hot pan after switching off the heat.

### 4. Make the pan sauce

While the steak rests, pour off excess fat and remove blackened residue, keeping the flavorful brown bits. Return to low heat, add 30 ml white wine or water and scrape the bottom. If using wine, reduce by about half to mellow its sharp aroma. Add 40 ml cream and gently thicken over low heat.

### 5. Finish off the heat

Turn off the heat and stir in 10 g whole-grain mustard and 5 g butter. Add black pepper, taste and adjust the salt. Add a little water if the sauce is too thick or strong. Slice the rested steak and serve with the sauce.

## Tips

- A wet surface uses heat to evaporate moisture, delaying browning. Too little heat also prolongs browning and can overcook the center; keeping the same heat after browning can toughen the outside. Control browning and center cooking as separate stages.
- The video's texture references are about 57°C for medium-rare, 63°C for medium and 71°C for well-done; these describe doneness preferences. USDA safety guidance for whole beef steaks is at least 63°C internally followed by at least 3 minutes of rest. A lower preference target does not meet that guidance. Color, touch and crust cannot replace a thermometer.
- This preparation uses a little butter at the start for flavor, so watch it for burning. The sauce butter is stirred in off the heat; these are different uses with different timing.
- Resting away from the pan avoids its continuing intense heat. Do not leave the meat in the original hot pan to rest.

title: 糖盐腌低温鸡胸肉
description: 修筋、糖盐腌制后温和水煮，测量中心熟度，再用黄油快速煎香表皮。
descriptionEn: Trim and season with salt and sugar, poach gently, check the center temperature and briefly brown the skin in butter.
body:
## 食材

- 带皮鸡胸肉 300 克
- 盐 3 克，为肉重的 1%
- 糖 1.5 克，为肉重的 0.5%
- 黄油适量
- 水

## 做法

### 1. 修整筋膜

摸清肉面坚硬的筋膜纹路，用刀尖小心切断，修去聚集的筋膜和残留硬筋，再用叉子在带皮一面扎孔，减少受热卷曲。用厨房纸吸干表面水分。

### 2. 糖盐腌制

把盐和糖均匀揉在鸡胸肉上，静置 10～20 分钟。使用袋装水煮时，选明确标注耐热且适合烹饪的食品袋，排出袋内空气后封好；也可不用袋，腌好后直接放入温水烹饪。

### 3. 温和水煮

把水烧开后关火，用温度计确认水温降至 80～85°C，再放入鸡胸肉。袋装时让鸡肉浸在水中，袋子不接触锅底或锅壁。以 23～25 分钟作为这份鸡胸肉的初次检查时间；水温、厚度和起始温度都会影响加热结果。

### 4. 测量中心温度

从最厚处测量中心温度，至少达到 74°C（165°F）才算完成这道鸡胸肉的熟度检查。若不足，把水重新加热至 80～85°C，继续浸煮几分钟后再测，直到中心达标。水温不是中心温度，不能只凭浸泡时间、肉色或按压手感判断熟透。

### 5. 快速煎香表面

取出鸡肉，擦干表面。锅中放黄油，以中火先煎带皮的一面，再翻面快速煎香，表皮上色后出锅切片。此时煎制主要负责表面香气，不靠长时间煎制补偿未经确认的中心熟度。

## 小贴士

- 厚鸡胸肉直接猛火煎，可能出现外面已焦、中心仍未熟；长时间翻滚水煮又容易让口感变紧。温和水煮与最后上色分开，较容易分别控制中心和表面。
- 生鸡肉修整后直接用厨房纸擦干，避免冲洗时溅水；及时清洁接触生鸡肉的手、器具和台面，避免交叉污染。
- 影片示例为水烧开关火后等 30 秒，但锅、水量与环境不同，不能据此认定水温一定降至 80～85°C；实际应测量水温。
- 盐和糖先均匀接触鸡肉，袋装能减少调味流失；不用袋时也先完成腌制。不要把任何普通密封袋都当作可加热烹饪袋。
- 中心至少 74°C（165°F）的检查也符合美国农业部禽肉安全建议；即使水温保持在 80～85°C，也必须确认中心温度。

## Ingredients

- 300 g skin-on chicken breast
- 3 g salt, 1% of the meat weight
- 1.5 g sugar, 0.5% of the meat weight
- Butter as needed
- Water

## Method

### 1. Trim the tendons

Feel for firm tendon lines on the flesh side. Carefully cut them with the knife tip, trim bundled tendons and remaining tough sinew, then pierce the skin side with a fork to reduce curling. Pat the surface dry with paper towels.

### 2. Season with salt and sugar

Rub salt and sugar evenly over the breast and rest for 10～20 minutes. For bagged poaching, use a food bag explicitly labeled heat-resistant and suitable for cooking, remove the air and seal. Alternatively, poach the seasoned chicken directly in the water without a bag.

### 3. Poach gently

Bring water to a boil, turn off the heat and use a thermometer to confirm it has cooled to 80～85°C before adding the chicken. With a bag, keep the meat submerged and prevent the bag from touching the bottom or sides of the pot. Use 23～25 minutes as the first checking point for this breast; water temperature, thickness and starting temperature affect the result.

### 4. Check the center temperature

Measure the center at the thickest part and confirm at least 74°C (165°F). If lower, reheat the water to 80～85°C, poach for a few more minutes and check again until the center reaches the target. Water temperature is not center temperature. Time, color and touch alone cannot establish doneness.

### 5. Briefly brown the surface

Remove the chicken and pat dry. Add butter to a pan and briefly sear over medium heat, skin side first, then turn and brown the other side. Remove and slice once colored. This stage develops surface flavor; prolonged searing should not substitute for checking the center earlier.

## Tips

- Fierce direct searing of a thick breast can brown the outside before the center cooks, while prolonged rolling boiling can make it firm. Separate gentle center cooking from final browning to control each stage.
- Pat the trimmed raw chicken dry directly with paper towels, avoiding splashes from washing. Clean hands, tools and surfaces that contact raw chicken promptly to prevent cross-contamination.
- The video waits 30 seconds after boiling and switching off the heat, but the pot, water quantity and surroundings affect cooling. Do not assume this always produces 80～85°C water; measure it.
- Rub the salt and sugar evenly over the meat first. A bag reduces seasoning loss; the bag-free version also starts with seasoning. Ordinary resealable bags are not automatically suitable for heated cooking.
- The center check of at least 74°C (165°F) also follows USDA poultry safety guidance. Even water maintained at 80～85°C does not replace measuring the center.

title: 蒜香彩椒蛋炒饭
titleEn: Garlic, pepper and egg fried rice
description: 冷却米饭先打散，少量加水松开饭粒，再交替摊煎和翻拌，最后沿锅边淋酱油。
descriptionEn: Loosen cooled rice with a little water, alternate pan contact with mixing and finish with soy sauce against the hot pan.
body:
## 食材

- 熟日式短粒米饭 200 克，也可用 Calrose 米或寿司米煮的饭
- 食用油 1 汤匙
- 鸡蛋 1 个
- 水 30 克
- 蒜 1 瓣
- 红甜椒 1/4 个
- 小青椒 1 个
- 盐 1 茶匙，按口味分次加入
- 酱油少许

## 做法

### 1. 备好米饭和配料

选已经冷却或表面稍干的熟米饭，避免刚出锅、湿软黏连的热饭。蒜切末；青椒和红甜椒去籽，修去内部白膜，切成小丁，让配料容易与饭粒均匀混合。

### 2. 热锅炒蛋

充分预热锅，再加入 1 汤匙油。以中火为基准，需要时增加火力。加入鸡蛋，先轻轻炒至开始凝固，再下米饭；不要预先把生蛋和米饭拌在一起。

### 3. 打散饭粒并加水

米饭入锅立刻用锅铲打散，避免整团反复翻动。加入 30 克水，边拌边松开饭粒，让米饭均匀受热，接着把加入的水分炒干。

### 4. 摊煎与翻拌交替

用锅铲把米饭摊开，让它接触锅底、收干表面并产生焦香，再翻拌，如此反复。需要时加大火力帮助水分蒸发；不用一直颠锅，也不要不停把米饭抛离锅面。

### 5. 加蒜和蔬菜

米饭已经散开、水分收干后加入蒜末，炒出香气，再加入青椒和红甜椒丁炒匀、炒熟。配料保持适量，避免一次加入太多使锅温下降、水分增多。

### 6. 调味收尾

把盐分次撒入并尝味，以简单调味保留米饭和蛋的香气。最后把少许酱油淋到空出的热锅边，待香气起来后迅速与米饭拌匀，出锅。

## 小贴士

- 这份短粒米炒饭加水是为了先松开饭团，再把水分蒸发掉；不是把湿饭长时间焖在锅里。饭粒散开后要给它接触热锅的时间。
- 先轻炒鸡蛋再加饭，能让蛋开始凝固；这套方法不采用生蛋预拌饭，也不把其他炒饭做法一概视为错误。
- 蒜也可以另选小火起炒、缓慢出香的顺序；这里用饭粒收干后加蒜的主流程，不必两个顺序都做。
- 配料过多容易降温，较干爽的蔬菜或已经充分炒熟的肉适合搭配；不要把生肉直接当作即熟配料加入这段收尾步骤。
- 酱油少量接触热锅后再拌饭，目的是获得焦香，避免直接往饭上集中倒入液体；这不是所有酱油调味的通用要求。

## 参考链接

## Ingredients

- 200 g cooked Japanese short-grain rice, or cooked Calrose or sushi rice
- 1 tablespoon cooking oil
- 1 egg
- 30 g water
- 1 garlic clove
- 1/4 red bell pepper
- 1 small green pepper
- 1 teaspoon salt, added gradually to taste
- A little soy sauce

## Method

### 1. Prepare the rice and vegetables

Use cooled cooked rice or rice with a slightly dry surface, avoiding freshly cooked, wet and sticky rice. Mince the garlic. Seed the peppers, remove the inner white membranes and dice finely so they mix evenly with the grains.

### 2. Heat the pan and cook the egg

Preheat the pan thoroughly, then add 1 tablespoon oil. Use medium heat as the starting point and increase it as needed. Add the egg and lightly cook until it begins to set before adding the rice. Do not premix raw egg with the rice for this method.

### 3. Break up the rice and add water

Immediately break up the rice with a spatula instead of turning whole clumps repeatedly. Add 30 g water and mix to loosen the grains and warm them evenly, then cook off the added moisture.

### 4. Alternate pan contact and mixing

Spread the rice with a spatula so it contacts the pan, dries on the surface and develops a toasted aroma, then mix and repeat. Increase the heat as needed to evaporate moisture. Constant tossing is unnecessary; avoid continually lifting the rice away from the hot surface.

### 5. Add garlic and peppers

Once the grains have separated and excess moisture has evaporated, add the garlic and cook until fragrant. Add the diced peppers and stir-fry until cooked. Keep additions moderate so they do not cool the pan and introduce excessive moisture.

### 6. Season and finish

Sprinkle in the salt gradually and taste, keeping the seasoning simple to preserve the rice and egg aromas. Finally, drizzle a little soy sauce onto an exposed hot edge of the pan. Let it become aromatic, quickly mix it through the rice and serve.

## Tips

- The water in this short-grain rice method first loosens clumps, then evaporates. It is not a method for leaving wet rice to steam for a long time. Once separated, give the grains contact with the hot pan.
- Briefly cooking the egg first lets it begin to set. This method avoids premixing raw egg and rice; that does not make every other fried-rice technique wrong.
- An alternative is to start garlic over low heat to develop its aroma gently. The main sequence here adds garlic after the rice dries; do not perform both sequences.
- Too many additions cool the pan. Relatively dry vegetables or thoroughly cooked meat suit this approach; do not treat raw meat as a ready-to-eat addition in these finishing steps.
- A little soy sauce contacts the hot pan for a toasted aroma before mixing into the rice, avoiding a concentrated splash of liquid directly on the grains. This is not a universal requirement for soy sauce seasoning.
