title: 椰汁西米露
description: 大小西米分开煮焖至透心，冲凉沥水，再拌入椰浆、牛奶、炼奶和水果。
descriptionEn: Cook and rest small and large sago pearls separately until translucent, rinse cool and mix with coconut milk, milk, condensed milk and fruit.
body:
## 食材

- 干小西米、干大西米按需，分别煮熟备用
- 椰浆 3 汤匙
- 牛奶 1 汤匙
- 炼奶 1 汤匙
- 煮熟的西米 4 汤匙：大西米、小西米各 2 汤匙
- 水果适量，切小块
- 清水，煮西米用
- 砂糖一大勺，仅在煮好后准备冷藏西米时使用

## 做法

### 1. 先烧足量开水

准备一大锅水，烧至沸腾。水量充足主要是为了保温。干西米直接下沸水，不要提前用冷水清洗或浸泡，以免淀粉球散开。

### 2. 小西米煮后加盖焖

把小西米倒入沸水，煮 1 分钟，关火并盖好锅盖。焖约 20 分钟后打开，搅动一下，检查中心；仍有小白心就继续加盖焖。焖至约 30 分钟时，再检查是否基本通透。这是先煮再焖，1 分钟不是总制作时间。

### 3. 大西米分段回煮再焖

大西米也从沸水下锅，煮 1 分钟，关火加盖。焖至 30 分钟时搅动检查，此时白心可能还很大，水温也已经下降；重新加热到沸腾后，关火加盖继续焖。到 60 分钟时再检查，有白心就再次煮沸、关火加盖。到约 90 分钟时检查，中心通透后再捞出。30、60、90 分钟是焖制过程中的累计检查时间，最终看是否透心。

### 4. 冲凉并沥水

煮透的西米用凉水多冲洗几遍，洗去表面黏液，直到摸起来不再黏手，水也清澈、冰凉，再沥水装好。这里冲洗的是已经煮熟的西米，与下锅前不能冷水浸洗干西米是两回事。

### 5. 需要冷藏时先拌糖

如果不马上吃，给这批沥水后的熟西米加一大勺砂糖，拌匀，封好保鲜膜放入冰箱冷藏，最好在 3 天内吃完。取出后简单搅动，使西米松散。这一步用于熟西米的单独备料；砂糖不是按每碗甜品固定添加，也不要把这段时间套用到混入奶和水果后的成品。

### 6. 调椰汁并组合

碗中放入 3 汤匙椰浆、1 汤匙牛奶、1 汤匙炼奶，拌匀。加入煮熟的大西米和小西米各 2 汤匙，混合后放入水果块即可。大小西米的口感不同，混合后能同时吃到小颗粒的软糯和大颗粒的弹性。

## 小贴士

- 这份方法针对木薯淀粉制成的西米。干西米不是普通米粒，不需要先淘洗；冷水洗泡可能使淀粉球散开，直接下沸水能让外层先糊化成形。
- 西米煮透既需要热量，也需要时间吸水。短时沸煮之后仍要加盖保温焖制，不能看见表面透明就忽略中心白心。
- 大西米需要更长时间，焖的过程中水温会下降，所以分段重新煮沸再焖。不要把小西米的时间直接套给大西米，也不要只按计时器判断熟度。
- 熟西米充分冲凉、洗去黏液，再沥水，有助于减少黏连；准备冷藏的熟西米拌入砂糖后，第二天更容易搅散。加糖是为了改善松散度，不能代替冷藏。
- 椰浆提供椰香，牛奶补充奶香，炼奶同时增加甜度和奶香。水果在组合时加入；没有薄荷叶也不影响完成这碗甜品。

## 参考链接

- [阿李厨房原视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rY3lcAk2Ne8)
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Dry small and large sago pearls as needed, cooked separately
- 3 tablespoons coconut milk
- 1 tablespoon milk
- 1 tablespoon sweetened condensed milk
- 4 tablespoons cooked sago pearls: 2 tablespoons each of large and small pearls
- Fruit as needed, diced
- Water for cooking the pearls
- One large spoonful of granulated sugar, only when refrigerating the cooked pearls

## Method

### 1. Bring plenty of water to a boil

Bring a large pot of water to a full boil. The generous volume primarily helps retain heat. Add dry pearls directly to boiling water; do not wash or soak them in cold water beforehand, as the starch balls can fall apart.

### 2. Boil and rest the small pearls

Add small pearls to boiling water, boil for 1 minute, then turn off the heat and cover. After about 20 minutes of covered resting, stir and check the centers. If small white cores remain, cover and continue resting. Check again at about 30 minutes for nearly complete translucency. This is a boil-and-rest method; 1 minute is not the total preparation time.

### 3. Reboil and rest the large pearls in stages

Start large pearls in boiling water too. Boil for 1 minute, turn off the heat and cover. At 30 minutes of resting, stir and check. The white cores may still be large and the water has cooled; bring back to a boil, then turn off the heat and cover again. Check at 60 minutes and repeat the boil-and-cover cycle if white cores remain. At about 90 minutes, check and remove once the centers are translucent. The 30, 60 and 90 minutes are cumulative checkpoints during resting; judge the result by the centers.

### 4. Rinse cool and drain

Rinse the cooked pearls several times with cool water to remove surface starch, until they no longer feel sticky and the water is clear and cold. Drain and transfer to a container. This rinsing is for cooked pearls, distinct from avoiding cold-water washing or soaking of dry pearls before cooking.

### 5. Mix with sugar if refrigerating

If not serving immediately, mix one large spoonful of granulated sugar into the drained batch of cooked pearls. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate, preferably using within 3 days. Stir briefly after taking them out to loosen them. This is separate storage of the cooked pearls: the sugar is not a fixed addition to every dessert bowl, and the storage period does not apply to a finished dessert mixed with dairy and fruit.

### 6. Mix the coconut base and assemble

Mix 3 tablespoons coconut milk, 1 tablespoon milk and 1 tablespoon sweetened condensed milk in a bowl. Stir in 2 tablespoons each of cooked large and small pearls, then add diced fruit. Mixing the sizes combines the soft chew of small pearls with the springier bite of large ones.

## Tips

- This method concerns tapioca-starch sago pearls. Dry pearls are not ordinary rice and need no preliminary washing. Cold washing or soaking can break them apart; boiling water helps their outer layer gelatinize and set first.
- Cooking pearls through requires both heat and time to absorb water. Keep them covered to retain heat after the brief boil; a translucent surface does not mean the white center is gone.
- Large pearls take longer and their resting water cools, so reboil in stages before continuing the covered rest. Do not apply the small-pearl timing to large pearls or rely only on the timer.
- Rinsing cooked pearls cool, removing surface starch and draining helps reduce sticking. Mixing sugar into pearls intended for refrigeration makes them easier to loosen the next day. Sugar helps separation; it does not replace refrigeration.
- Coconut milk provides coconut aroma, milk adds dairy flavor, and condensed milk adds sweetness and richness. Add fruit when assembling; the dessert needs no mint leaf to be complete.

## References

title: 阿伟的六款电饭锅焖饭
description: 六种独立做法，分别准备和烹煮。
descriptionEn: Six independent preparations, each cooked separately.
body:
## 食材

- 各款均用淘好的米和清水；其余食材见对应做法。

## 做法

### 1. 板栗排骨焖饭

锅里加油炒香姜片、葱段，下洗净的肋排生煸至表面微微出油，沿锅边淋花雕酒。加鲜香菇、胡萝卜、板栗和清水，小火加一小勺盐、白胡椒粉、蚝油、生抽，盖上烧开。连汤倒入放有淘好米的电饭锅，以平常煮饭的水量为参照，用煮饭模式煮 40 分钟，撒葱花；喜欢深色可加几滴老抽。

### 2. 腊肠土豆焖饭

少油炒香姜片、葱段和广式腊肠，待腊肠出油，加入玉米、青豆、胡萝卜和土豆。加一勺盐、白胡椒粉、蚝油，不加生抽。加清水，盖上煮 1 分钟，烧开后连汤倒入淘好的米，用筷子拨匀，煮饭模式煮 40 分钟。挑出姜片，撒葱花。

### 3. 香芋板栗焖饭

少油、小火煸去皮五花肉，出香吐油后沿锅边淋花雕酒，加姜片、葱段和少许老抽。加入香芋煎炒，再加干香菇、板栗和磷虾或虾皮。炒香后加 2 碗清水、盐、小半勺白糖、蚝油、胡椒粉，煮 1 分钟。烧开后倒入淘好的米，把芋头压入水中，煮饭模式煮 40 分钟。挑出姜葱，撒葱花拌匀。

### 4. 南瓜牛肉焖饭

牛排切条，抓匀黑胡椒柠檬海盐、玉米淀粉和少许油。热锅少油煎香牛肉，加姜片、葱段、干香菇、胡萝卜、青豆和贝贝南瓜翻炒。加 2 碗清水，盖上烧开，调入一小勺盐和蚝油。倒入淘好的米，筷子压匀，煮饭模式煮 40 分钟，挑出姜葱。

### 5. 腊肠窝蛋时蔬饭

米按平常水量先煮 20 分钟，摆入胡萝卜、青菜、玉米粒和腊肠，中间打入鸡蛋，再煮 20 分钟。用 1.5 勺生抽、1 勺芝麻香油、0.5 勺蚝油和 2.5 勺纯净水调汁，煮好后均匀淋入。

### 6. 咖喱鸡腿焖饭

去骨鸡腿切块，抓匀盐、白胡椒粉、花雕酒、姜葱和少许生抽，再抓入 2 勺玉米淀粉，淋少许油，腌 5 分钟。热油煎香鸡肉，炒香洋葱，再加入胡萝卜、土豆、鲜香菇。加 1 碗牛奶、1 碗水和 3 块咖喱膏，盖上烧 2 分钟。烧开后倒入淘好的米，筷子压匀，煮饭模式煮 40 分钟。

## 小贴士

- 排骨可直接煸炒，也可按需要先焯水再炒。腊肠和五花肉会出油，起锅油不宜多。
- 香芋选熟后粉糯、轻压易碎的品种，先煎更香。牛肉先煎更香，赶时间也可直接焖。
- 咖喱饭可用椰浆代替牛奶，成品宜略湿润，喜欢干一些可少加水。各款肉和蔬菜可按需要替换。

## 参考链接

- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vq3_Clzyg2E)
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Each preparation uses rinsed rice and water; other ingredients appear in its method.

## Method

### 1. Chestnut and pork rib rice

Heat oil with ginger slices and scallion sections. Add washed pork ribs and fry until they begin to release fat; pour Shaoxing wine around the pan edge. Add fresh shiitake, carrot, chestnuts and water. Over low heat season with a small spoonful of salt, white pepper, oyster sauce and light soy sauce; cover and bring to a boil. Pour everything over rinsed rice in the rice cooker, using your normal rice-cooking water amount as a guide. Cook on the rice setting for 40 minutes and finish with chopped scallions. Add a few drops of dark soy sauce if a deeper color is desired.

### 2. Chinese sausage and potato rice

Use a little oil to fry ginger, scallion sections and Cantonese sausage until fragrant and the sausage releases fat. Add corn, peas, carrot and potato. Season with a spoonful of salt, white pepper and oyster sauce, without light soy sauce. Add water, cover and boil for 1 minute. Pour over rinsed rice, distribute evenly with chopsticks and cook on the rice setting for 40 minutes. Remove ginger and finish with scallions.

### 3. Taro and chestnut rice

Fry skinless pork belly gently over low heat with a little oil until fragrant and releasing fat. Pour Shaoxing wine around the edge; add ginger, scallion sections and a little dark soy sauce. Pan-fry taro, then add dried shiitake, chestnuts and krill or dried tiny shrimp. Once fragrant, add 2 bowls of water, salt, a scant half spoonful of sugar, oyster sauce and pepper. Boil for 1 minute, pour over rinsed rice and press the taro under the liquid. Cook on the rice setting for 40 minutes. Remove ginger and scallion sections, then add chopped scallions and mix.

### 4. Pumpkin and beef rice

Cut steak into strips and mix with black-pepper lemon sea salt, cornstarch and a little oil. Sear in a little hot oil; add ginger, scallion sections, dried shiitake, carrot, peas and small pumpkin, and stir-fry. Add 2 bowls of water, cover and bring to a boil; season with a small spoonful of salt and oyster sauce. Pour over rinsed rice and press ingredients down with chopsticks. Cook on the rice setting for 40 minutes and remove ginger and scallion sections.

### 5. Sausage, egg and vegetable rice

Cook rice with your usual amount of water for 20 minutes. Arrange carrot, leafy greens, corn and Chinese sausage on top, crack an egg into the center and cook for another 20 minutes. Mix 1.5 spoonfuls light soy sauce, 1 spoonful sesame oil, 0.5 spoonful oyster sauce and 2.5 spoonfuls drinking water; drizzle evenly over the cooked rice.

### 6. Curry chicken rice

Dice boneless chicken thighs and mix with salt, white pepper, Shaoxing wine, ginger, scallions and a little light soy sauce. Mix in 2 spoonfuls cornstarch, coat with a little oil and marinate for 5 minutes. Brown in hot oil, fry onion until fragrant, then add carrot, potato and fresh shiitake. Add 1 bowl milk, 1 bowl water and 3 pieces curry roux; cover and cook for 2 minutes. Once boiling, pour over rinsed rice, press ingredients down and cook on the rice setting for 40 minutes.

## Tips

- Ribs can be fried directly or blanched first as needed. Sausage and pork belly release fat, so begin with little oil.
- Choose taro that cooks floury and crumbles under gentle pressure; pan-frying improves aroma. Searing beef also improves aroma, but it can also cook directly with the rice when short of time.
- Coconut milk can replace milk in the curry rice. Keep it slightly moist, or reduce water for a drier result. Meat and vegetables may be varied for each preparation.

## References

- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vq3_Clzyg2E)

title: 萝洁塔的番茄炖牛肉与意面
titleEn: Rosalina’s tomato beef stew with pasta
description: 牛肋条与番茄酱小火炖软，可直接吃或搭配意面。
descriptionEn: Beef rib fingers simmered in tomato sauce, served alone or with pasta.
body:
## 食材

- 去多余脂肪的牛肋条约 750 克；牛番茄 2～3 个；大洋葱 1 个；蒜苗 1 株（可省）；蒜末约 35 克。
- 番茄意面酱 340 克；水半罐；烟熏红椒粉 7～10 克；伍斯特酱 30 ml（可省）；盐、黑胡椒、白胡椒、混合香料、辣椒粉、橄榄油；意面。

## 做法

### 1. 处理食材

洋葱切细丁，蒜切末，蒜苗白部切片，番茄切大丁，皮可留可去。牛肉洗净擦干，修去多余脂肪但保留部分，切块，用盐、黑胡椒、少许白胡椒和混合香料抓匀。

### 2. 炼油分批煎肉

修下的牛脂放冷锅，中火慢慢炼油，不用大火。取出一半油备用，剩余油中分批煎牛肉，待两面微焦上色后取出。

### 3. 炒香蔬菜香料

补回备用牛油，不足可加橄榄油。炒洋葱至透明，加入蒜苗白部炒香，再下蒜末。牛肉连肉汁回锅拌匀，加入烟熏红椒粉、可选的辣椒粉、盐、黑胡椒和混合香料炒香，再加番茄拌匀。

### 4. 小火炖软并配餐

倒入番茄意面酱，空罐加半罐水摇匀倒入，可加入伍斯特酱。尝味补盐，盖上转最小火炖 60 分钟，开盖尝味，确认牛肉软嫩。可直接吃，或配意面，把酱汁浇上让意面吸收。

## 小贴士

- 细切洋葱更容易融入酱汁。牛肉不要一次全部下锅，避免锅温骤降，也便于逐块均匀上色。
- 可用部分牛腱替换牛肋条，但原作者不建议全部换成瘦牛腱，保留脂肪风味更足。番茄酱承担酱底，不用另备高汤或红酒；鲜番茄也可省。

## 参考链接

- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QttPBfho4_Q)
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- About 750 g trimmed beef rib fingers; 2～3 tomatoes; 1 large onion; 1 garlic shoot (optional); about 35 g minced garlic.
- 340 g tomato pasta sauce; half a jar water; 7～10 g smoked paprika; 30 ml Worcestershire sauce (optional); salt, black pepper, white pepper, mixed herbs, chili powder and olive oil; pasta.

## Method

### 1. Prepare ingredients

Finely dice onion, mince garlic, slice the white part of the garlic shoot and dice tomatoes, peeled or unpeeled. Wash and dry beef, trim excess fat while retaining some, cut into pieces and mix with salt, black pepper, a little white pepper and mixed herbs.

### 2. Render fat and brown in batches

Start the trimmed fat in a cold pot and render slowly over medium heat, avoiding high heat. Reserve half the fat; brown beef in batches in the remaining fat until both sides color, then remove.

### 3. Build the aromatic base

Return reserved beef fat, adding olive oil if needed. Fry onion until translucent, then garlic shoot whites and minced garlic until fragrant. Return beef with its juices. Fry with smoked paprika, optional chili powder, salt, black pepper and mixed herbs, then stir in tomatoes.

### 4. Simmer and serve

Add tomato pasta sauce. Shake half a jar of water in the empty jar and pour it in; add optional Worcestershire sauce. Taste for salt, cover and simmer on the lowest heat for 60 minutes. Taste again and check that the beef is tender. Serve alone or with pasta, pouring the sauce over it so it absorbs the flavor.

## Tips

- Finely chopped onion melts into the sauce more readily. Avoid adding all the beef at once: batches limit the temperature drop and allow even browning.
- Some rib fingers may be replaced with shank, but the creator advises against replacing all of them because some fat contributes flavor. Tomato sauce provides the base without stock or red wine; fresh tomatoes are also optional.

title: 小高姐羊肉手抓饭与基础白饭
titleEn: Gao’s lamb pilaf and basic white rice
description: 先掌握煮、焖、散气，再用羊肉汤焖饭。
descriptionEn: Learn simmering, covered resting and steam release, then apply them to lamb pilaf.
body:
## 食材

- 白饭：印度香米 500 ml，水 1000 ml。
- 抓饭：带骨羊肉 500 克，腌肉盐 1 茶匙、小苏打 1/2 茶匙；洋葱半个，胡萝卜 2～3 个，油 2 汤匙，盐 1 茶匙，粗孜然粉 1 茶匙，粗香菜籽粉 1 茶匙（可省），炖肉水 1 杯，印度香米 500 ml，汤汁加水合计 1000 ml，葡萄干。

## 做法

### 1. 基础白饭

选导热好、密封好的锅。放米和水拌平，盖上大火烧开，转小火煮 12 分钟，中途不开盖不搅拌。关火不开盖焖 5 分钟，再开盖，轻翻几下散去底部水汽，蒸汽散后盖上保温。

### 2. 腌羊肉与切菜

羊排、羊肩或羊腿用腌肉盐和小苏打腌 15 分钟，冲洗掉表面盐和小苏打，捞出擦干。洋葱切丝，胡萝卜斜切片再竖切条。

### 3. 煎香后炖软

热油下洋葱，刚变色时加羊肉，中火铺开煎，底部上色后翻面，煎至肉与洋葱焦黄后盛出。用锅里混有羊脂的油炒胡萝卜、盐、孜然和香菜籽粉，出香后回入羊肉洋葱，翻炒加炖肉水。烧开转小火炖 30 分钟，至筷子轻松扎入。

### 4. 计量汤汁并焖抓饭

剩汤约 100 ml，也可滤入量杯实量，补水使汤水总量达到配方用量，不要另加完整份量的清水。将肉、菜、米和汤水放入密封好的锅，拌平米，尝汤补盐。盖上烧开，加葡萄干，再盖好，小火煮 15 分钟，关火焖 5 分钟，开盖轻翻散气。米粒饱满、锅底无多余水，羊肉软至易脱骨。

## 小贴士

- 印度香米的示范体积比为 1:2；不同米应参考包装水量与煮制时间，不能套用。未泡米可延长 1～2 分钟。免洗印度香米可不洗；洗米能去表面淀粉，但此米本身较松散。
- 刚熟的长米粒柔软易断，散气轻翻即可，不要来回搅拌。洋葱先煎焦黄，后续炖软融入汤。抓饭有肉菜油脂，煮饭时间比白饭更长。

## 参考链接

- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2VRRTq7FhEA)
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- White rice: 500 ml basmati rice and 1000 ml water.
- Pilaf: 500 g bone-in lamb; 1 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon baking soda for marinating; half an onion; 2～3 carrots; 2 tablespoons oil; 1 teaspoon salt; 1 teaspoon coarse cumin; 1 teaspoon coarse ground coriander seed (optional); 1 cup water for braising; 500 ml basmati rice; broth plus water totaling 1000 ml; raisins.

## Method

### 1. Basic white rice

Use a pot with good heat conduction and a tight lid. Add rice and water, stir level, cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce to low and simmer for 12 minutes without opening or stirring. Turn off the heat and rest covered for 5 minutes. Uncover and gently turn the rice a few times to release steam from the bottom; cover again after steam escapes to keep warm.

### 2. Marinate lamb and cut vegetables

Marinate lamb chops, shoulder or leg with the marinating salt and baking soda for 15 minutes. Rinse away surface salt and baking soda and pat dry. Slice onion; cut carrots diagonally into slices, then lengthwise into strips.

### 3. Brown and braise

Fry onion in hot oil; as it begins to color, add lamb in a single layer over medium heat. Turn when the underside browns; remove when lamb and onion are golden brown. In the remaining oil and rendered lamb fat, fry carrots, salt, cumin and coriander seed until fragrant. Return lamb and onion, stir and add the braising water. Bring to a boil and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes, until chopsticks enter the meat easily.

### 4. Measure broth and cook pilaf

About 100 ml broth remains in the demonstration; measure it in a jug if unsure. Add water to reach the specified total liquid rather than adding a full separate portion of water. Combine meat, vegetables, rice and liquid in a tightly covered pot, level the rice and taste the broth for salt. Cover and bring to a boil, add raisins, cover again and simmer on low for 15 minutes. Rest off heat for 5 minutes, then uncover and turn gently to release steam. Rice should be plump without excess water at the bottom, and lamb tender enough to come off the bone.

## Tips

- The demonstrated basmati volume ratio is 1:2; check the package for other rice varieties and their cooking times. Unsoaked rice may need 1～2 minutes longer. No-wash basmati need not be washed; washing removes surface starch, but this rice is naturally loose.
- Freshly cooked long grains are fragile; turn gently to release steam rather than stirring repeatedly. Brown onion first so it later softens into the broth. The pilaf cooks longer than plain rice because it contains meat, vegetables and fat.

title: 阿栗葱香千层肉饼
description: 半烫面配葱油酥，包入肉末和葱花。
descriptionEn: Partially scalded dough layered with scallion oil paste, meat and scallions.
body:
## 食材

- 做 5 个。面团：中筋面粉 500 克，开水 250 克，室温水 100 克，油 30 克。
- 油酥：油 100 克，中筋面粉 70 克，盐 3 克，花椒粉 2 克，五香粉 2 克；小葱共 200 克，葱白炼油、葱叶切碎。
- 肉馅：猪肉末或牛肉末 350 克，姜末 5 克，盐 5～6 克，白胡椒粉 3 克，炸香的葱白；芝麻，煎饼用油。

## 做法

### 1. 半烫面并醒面

面粉分两部分，一半加开水拌开，再逐渐混入另一半。加室温水和油，揉 3～5 分钟，醒 20 分钟，再揉 3～5 分钟至光滑。分成 5 份，滚圆放进抹油容器，表面刷油，醒 60 分钟。

### 2. 炸葱油调油酥与肉馅

小葱分葱白与葱叶，葱叶切碎。把油酥面粉、花椒粉、五香粉和盐拌合。油烧热，下葱白炸至金黄，捞出留作肉馅，趁热把葱油倒入油酥粉料拌匀。肉末加姜末、盐、白胡椒和炸葱白拌匀。

### 3. 抻薄包馅

案板抹少许油，把醒好的面团用手慢慢摊薄，均匀抹油酥，薄铺肉馅，撒葱花，沿长边卷起包住馅，卷成粗条后从一端盘成圆形，再压成较厚的饼，撒芝麻，再醒 15 分钟。

### 4. 压薄煎熟

放在烘焙纸上用手压至约 0.5 厘米厚。平底锅加少许油，不粘锅可不加油，中火煎，每 1～2 分钟翻面，约 5～6 分钟煎熟。

## 小贴士

- 充分醒面后延展性好，摊得薄，层次更多；包馅时少量破皮露馅是正常的。
- 面团和肉馅可前一晚准备后冷藏，压薄的生饼可冷冻，想吃时再煎。

## 参考链接

- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Qz9Z0L8hHE4)
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Makes 5. Dough: 500 g all-purpose flour, 250 g boiling water, 100 g room-temperature water and 30 g oil.
- Paste: 100 g oil, 70 g all-purpose flour, 3 g salt, 2 g ground Sichuan pepper and 2 g five-spice powder; 200 g scallions in total, whites for frying and greens chopped.
- Filling: 350 g ground pork or beef, 5 g minced ginger, 5～6 g salt, 3 g white pepper and the fried scallion whites; sesame seeds and oil for frying.

## Method

### 1. Scald part of the flour and rest

Divide flour into two portions. Stir boiling water into one half, then gradually incorporate the other half. Add room-temperature water and oil, knead for 3～5 minutes, rest for 20 minutes and knead for another 3～5 minutes until smooth. Divide into 5 balls, place in an oiled container, brush with oil and rest for 60 minutes.

### 2. Make scallion oil paste and filling

Separate scallion whites and greens; chop greens. Combine the paste flour, Sichuan pepper, five-spice and salt. Heat oil and fry whites until golden; reserve them for the filling. Pour hot scallion oil into the paste ingredients and mix. Combine meat with ginger, salt, white pepper and the fried whites.

### 3. Stretch and fill

Oil the board lightly and slowly stretch each rested dough ball thin by hand. Spread with paste, add a thin layer of meat and sprinkle with scallion greens. Roll up along the long side to enclose the filling, coil the log from one end into a round, then press into a thick pancake, sprinkle with sesame and rest for 15 minutes.

### 4. Flatten and fry

Press by hand on baking paper to about 0.5 cm thick. Add a little oil to a frying pan, or omit it in a nonstick pan. Fry over medium heat, turning every 1～2 minutes, for about 5～6 minutes until cooked.

## Tips

- Well-rested dough stretches readily; stretching it thin creates more layers. Small tears exposing filling during shaping are normal.
- Dough and filling can be prepared the night before and refrigerated. The flattened uncooked pancakes may be frozen for later frying.

title: 留意美食家常炒面
description: 先煮、冷却沥干并拌油上色，分次加入蒜末炒香。
descriptionEn: Parboil, cool and drain the noodles, coat with oil and dark soy sauce, then add garlic in stages.
body:
## 食材

- 新鲜碱面条、青菜、洋葱、胡萝卜、火腿肠、鸡蛋、大蒜
- 白醋、植物油、菜籽油、老抽
- 麻辣鲜约 5 克、生抽约 10 克
- 盐、鸡精、胡椒粉、芝麻香油

## 做法

### 1. 切配

粗青菜切细，洋葱切细丝。胡萝卜斜切稍厚片再切细丝，火腿肠切厚片再切条。大蒜拍碎剁末，多备一些。鸡蛋加少许白醋打散。

### 2. 煮面并拌油

水中放少许植物油，煮沸后保持大火下鲜面，推动使受热均匀。再次沸腾后分两到三次加冷水；约 40 秒，煮至七成熟。捞入冷水中搅动，泡凉后捞出，充分沥干。拌入稍多植物油和适量老抽，慢慢翻匀上色。

### 3. 炒鸡蛋

烧干锅底水分，加稍多植物油润锅。倒入蛋液推动，炒至定型且表面微黄，盛出。

### 4. 炒配菜和面

锅中加菜籽油烧出香味，下半量蒜末炒香，再放胡萝卜、洋葱、火腿炒约 10 秒。加青菜炒至刚变软，约 5～6 秒；放面条翻炒，加麻辣鲜、生抽、少许盐、鸡精和胡椒粉拌匀。

### 5. 大火收尾

放回鸡蛋，加入剩余蒜末，大火翻炒数下出香味。淋少许芝麻香油，再翻炒几下，关火装盘。

## 小贴士

- 小棵鸡毛菜也适合；粗菜切细有助于熟透入味。洋葱和最后加入的蒜末用于增香。
- 面条不要煮得太久；冷却、沥干、拌油和老抽后再炒，能减少粘连并使颜色均匀。鸡蛋为炒面炒得稍老、微黄。

## 参考链接

[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gN1QkOQuT7E)
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Fresh alkaline noodles, leafy greens, onion, carrot, ham sausage, eggs and garlic
- White vinegar, vegetable oil, rapeseed oil and dark soy sauce
- Mala seasoning blend about 5 g; light soy sauce about 10 g
- Salt, chicken seasoning, pepper and sesame oil

## Method

### 1. Prepare

Slice thick greens finely and shred the onion. Cut the carrot diagonally into slightly thick slices, then fine strips; cut the sausage into thick slices, then strips. Crush and mince a generous amount of garlic. Beat the eggs with a little white vinegar.

### 2. Parboil and coat the noodles

Add a little vegetable oil to water, bring to a boil and add fresh noodles over high heat. Stir to heat evenly. After boiling resumes, add cold water in two or three additions; cook for about 40 seconds until partly cooked, roughly seven-tenths done. Transfer to cold water, stir and let cool. Drain very thoroughly. Gently toss with a generous coating of vegetable oil and dark soy sauce to color evenly.

### 3. Cook the eggs

Dry the pan over heat and coat thoroughly with a generous amount of vegetable oil. Add the eggs and push gently until set and lightly golden on the surface; remove.

### 4. Stir-fry the vegetables and noodles

Heat rapeseed oil until fragrant. Fry half the garlic, then add carrot, onion and sausage for about 10 seconds. Add greens and fry until just softened, about 5～6 seconds. Add noodles and toss; mix in mala seasoning, light soy sauce, a little salt, chicken seasoning and pepper.

### 5. Finish over high heat

Return the eggs and add the remaining garlic. Toss several times over high heat until fragrant. Add a little sesame oil, toss briefly and turn off the heat to serve.

## Tips

- Small tender greens also work; finely cutting thicker greens helps them cook and take seasoning. Onion and the final garlic addition supply aroma.
- Do not overboil the noodles. Cooling, draining and coating with oil and dark soy sauce before frying reduce sticking and distribute color. Cook the eggs slightly firmer and lightly golden for this stir-fry.

title: 冯小厨牛肉炒米粉
description: 用新竹米粉搭配牛肉、鸡蛋和清脆包菜，沥干后大火拌炒。
descriptionEn: Hsinchu rice vermicelli tossed with beef, egg and crisp cabbage after thorough draining.
body:
## 食材

- 新竹米粉、牛肉吊龙
- 包菜半个、胡萝卜半根、洋葱一小半、豆芽、小葱
- 鸡蛋 2 个、食用油、猪油
- 松茸鲜、料酒、生抽、老抽
- 盐一大勺、蚝油半勺；鸡蛋另加少许盐
- 油辣子（食用时可选）

## 做法

### 1. 泡米粉与切菜

米粉用温水泡 10 分钟。包菜切丝、洗净，胡萝卜和洋葱切丝，豆芽洗净。小葱分出葱白和葱段。

### 2. 腌肉与沥粉

牛肉先切片再切细条，加松茸鲜、少许料酒和酱油抓匀腌制。泡好的米粉过凉水，攥干水分，抓入食用油防粘。鸡蛋加少许盐打匀。

### 3. 炒蛋和牛肉

铁锅烧热加油，倒蛋液迅速划散，炒好盛出。锅中放猪油炒化，爆香葱白，下牛肉炒至变色，再下洋葱炒香。

### 4. 拌炒米粉

下包菜、胡萝卜和豆芽，炒至蔬菜变软、豆芽变软。放米粉，加盐，沿锅边淋生抽，加少许老抽上色及蚝油，放回鸡蛋。大火用筷子翻拌均匀，最后加葱段拌匀。食用时可配油辣子。

## 小贴士

- 家用灶火力有限，米粉水分要攥干，免得炒时粘连；筷子有助于均匀翻拌。
- 包菜提供清脆口感，小白菜不能达到相同效果。牛肉可按喜好改用猪前腿肉、火腿肠或虾仁。

bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Hsinchu rice vermicelli and diaolong beef
- Half a cabbage, half a carrot, a small portion of onion, bean sprouts and scallions
- 2 eggs, cooking oil and lard
- Matsutake seasoning, cooking wine, light soy sauce and dark soy sauce
- Salt one large spoonful and oyster sauce half a spoonful; a little extra salt for the eggs
- Chili oil, optional at the table

## Method

### 1. Soak noodles and cut vegetables

Soak vermicelli in warm water for 10 minutes. Shred and wash the cabbage; shred carrot and onion and wash sprouts. Separate scallion whites from the remaining sections.

### 2. Marinate beef and drain noodles

Slice beef, then cut into thin strips. Mix with matsutake seasoning and a little cooking wine and soy sauce to marinate. Rinse the soaked noodles in cold water, squeeze out water and toss with cooking oil to prevent clumping. Beat eggs with a little salt.

### 3. Cook eggs and beef

Heat an iron wok with oil, add eggs and quickly scramble; remove. Melt lard in the wok and fry scallion whites until fragrant. Add beef and fry until its color changes, then add onion and fry until fragrant.

### 4. Toss the vermicelli

Add cabbage, carrot and sprouts and fry until vegetables and sprouts soften. Add vermicelli and salt, pour light soy sauce around the wok edge and add a little dark soy sauce for color and the oyster sauce. Return eggs. Toss evenly over high heat using chopsticks, then mix in scallion sections. Serve with optional chili oil.

## Tips

- Home burners have limited power, so squeeze the noodles dry to reduce sticking; chopsticks help mix them evenly.
- Cabbage supplies a crisp texture that small bok choy does not match. Pork foreleg meat, ham sausage or shrimp may replace beef to taste.

title: 阿见葱盐猪排
description: 梅花肉薄裹红薯淀粉煎香，再以葱蒜芝麻盐料小火炒匀。
descriptionEn: Thinly starch-coated pork collar chops pan-fried, then tossed gently with scallion, garlic and sesame seasoning.
body:
## 食材

- 梅花肉薄片约一斤半
- 蚝油、生抽、白胡椒粉、清水
- 红薯淀粉两大把、食用油
- 大蒜一大把、小葱一把
- 盐一小勺、白糖一小勺、胡椒粉一小勺
- 白芝麻一大勺、香油

## 做法

### 1. 腌制与裹粉

梅花肉两面用刀背或叉子拍松、扎孔。加蚝油、生抽、白胡椒粉和清水抓匀，腌 10 分钟。加红薯淀粉抓匀，肉片薄薄裹上一层粉浆。

### 2. 调葱盐料

蒜拍扁切末，小葱切葱花，放碗里。加盐、白糖、胡椒粉、白芝麻和香油，充分拌匀。

### 3. 中小火煎熟

锅热下油，油热后放猪排，中小火慢煎。底部定型再翻面，之后多翻几次，煎至肉彻底熟透且两面金黄焦香，盛出。

### 4. 趁热切块回锅

猪排趁热切小块，倒回锅里，加葱盐料，小火煸炒至葱蒜香味释放并与肉拌匀，出锅。

## 小贴士

- 薄片容易入味、煎熟；两面拍松或扎孔后再腌制。黑胡椒也可替代白胡椒。
- 大片猪排不可用最大火急煎，以免外层焦糊而里面未熟。热油下肉有助于避免粘锅；底面定型后再翻。
- 趁热切、趁热吃，冷后外皮会失去酥脆。这是咸香葱蒜调味，也含少量糖。

## 参考链接

[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0hDfXBQhiZg)
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Thin pork collar slices, about one and a half jin
- Oyster sauce, light soy sauce, white pepper and water
- Two large handfuls of sweet potato starch and cooking oil
- A large handful of garlic and a handful of scallions
- One small spoonful each of salt, sugar and pepper
- One large spoonful of white sesame seeds and sesame oil

## Method

### 1. Marinate and coat

Tenderize or pierce both sides of the pork collar slices with a knife spine or fork. Massage with oyster sauce, light soy sauce, white pepper and water; marinate for 10 minutes. Mix in sweet potato starch until the meat carries a thin batter coating.

### 2. Mix scallion seasoning

Crush and mince garlic; finely chop scallions and place both in a bowl. Thoroughly mix with salt, sugar, pepper, white sesame seeds and sesame oil.

### 3. Pan-fry over medium-low heat

Heat the pan, add oil and wait until the oil is hot before adding pork. Fry slowly over medium-low heat. Turn once the underside has set, then turn several more times until thoroughly cooked and golden and fragrant on both sides. Remove.

### 4. Cut hot and return to the pan

Cut the pork into small pieces while hot and return to the pan. Add the scallion seasoning and toss over low heat until the garlic and scallion are fragrant and coat the meat; serve.

## Tips

- Thin slices take seasoning and cook more readily; tenderize or pierce both sides before marinating. Black pepper may replace white pepper.
- Do not rush large chops over maximum heat: the coating can burn before the inside cooks. Add meat to hot oil to help reduce sticking and let the underside set before turning.
- Cut and eat while hot; the coating loses crispness as it cools. This is a savory scallion-garlic seasoning that also contains a little sugar.

title: 葱香凉拌面
description: 用葱油激香蒜末、芝麻和辣椒，拌入黄瓜、香菜与花生。
descriptionEn: Hot scallion oil releases the aroma of garlic, sesame and chili before the noodles are tossed with cucumber, cilantro and peanuts.
body:
## 食材

- 干面条一把
- 黄瓜 1 根
- 香菜 1 根
- 葱数根
- 蒜
- 白芝麻 1 勺
- 辣椒面
- 花椒粉 1 小勺
- 食用油
- 盐，另备煮面用盐 1 勺
- 鸡精少许
- 白糖少许
- 生抽 2 勺
- 老抽半勺
- 芝麻香油
- 油炸花生米一把

## 做法

### 1. 切好配菜

蒜拍松切末。葱切出葱花和葱段，分别放好。香菜切段，黄瓜先切片，再切细丝。

### 2. 激香料碗

碗中放蒜末、葱花、白芝麻、辣椒面和花椒粉。锅中加油烧热，放入葱段炸香后捞出。把热葱油浇入料碗，激出香味。

### 3. 调好拌汁

加入盐、鸡精、白糖、生抽和老抽，拌匀，再加入芝麻香油拌匀。

### 4. 煮面过凉

锅中水烧至底部微微冒泡，加煮面用盐，放入面条并拨散，使面条受热均匀。水开后加一次凉水，再次煮开后再加一次凉水。继续煮至面条熟透，捞出放入凉白开中过凉，再充分沥水。

### 5. 拌匀装碗

面条放入大碗，加入黄瓜丝、香菜和调好的拌汁，再放油炸花生米，拌匀。

## 小贴士

- 葱段先在油里炸香后捞出，热油再浇料碗，让葱油和碗中香料各自发挥香味。
- 煮面时把面条拨散，并在煮开后分次加凉水，是这款干面条的处理方法；煮好后过凉、沥水，再拌汁。

## Ingredients

- A handful of dried noodles
- 1 cucumber
- 1 cilantro sprig
- A few scallions
- Garlic

- Chili powder
- 1 small spoonful ground Sichuan pepper
- Cooking oil
- Salt, plus 1 spoonful for cooking the noodles
- A little chicken bouillon powder
- A little sugar
- 2 spoonfuls light soy sauce
- Half a spoonful dark soy sauce
- Sesame oil
- A handful of fried peanuts

## Method

### 1. Prepare the vegetables

Crush and mince the garlic. Cut some scallion into small pieces and some into sections, keeping them separate. Cut the cilantro into sections. Slice the cucumber, then cut it into fine strips.

### 2. Release the aromatics

Put the garlic, finely cut scallion, sesame seeds, chili powder and ground Sichuan pepper in a bowl. Heat cooking oil in a pan, fry the scallion sections until fragrant, then remove them. Pour the hot scallion oil over the aromatics in the bowl.

### 3. Mix the dressing

Stir in salt, chicken bouillon powder, sugar, light soy sauce and dark soy sauce. Add sesame oil and mix again.

### 4. Cook and cool the noodles

Heat water until small bubbles appear at the bottom of the pot. Add the salt for cooking the noodles, add the noodles and separate them so they heat evenly. Once the water boils, add cold water. When it boils again, add cold water again. Continue cooking until the noodles are cooked through. Lift them into cooled boiled water, then drain thoroughly.

### 5. Toss and serve

Put the noodles in a large bowl. Add the cucumber, cilantro and dressing, then add the fried peanuts and toss well.

## Tips

- Fry and remove the scallion sections first, then pour the hot oil over the bowl of aromatics to develop both layers of aroma.
- Separating the noodles and adding cold water after the water boils are the demonstrated method for these dried noodles. Cool and drain them before adding the dressing.

title: 杰少滑蛋虾仁
description: 蛋黄与蛋白分开处理，虾仁先炒后沥干，再与蛋液快炒。
descriptionEn: Handle yolks and whites separately, cook and drain the shrimp, then quickly fold them through the eggs.
body:
## 食材

- 鲜虾 14 只
- 鸡蛋 6 个
- 葱 1 条
- 盐
- 胡椒粉
- 生粉
- 麻油
- 生抽少许
- 食用油

## 做法

### 1. 腌好虾仁

鲜虾剥壳取虾仁。加盐、胡椒粉、生粉和麻油，用手拌匀。葱切成葱花。

### 2. 分开处理鸡蛋

把蛋黄和蛋白分装。蛋黄加入少许生抽，搅拌均匀；蛋白暂时另放，不要一开始就全部混合。

### 3. 炒虾并沥干

锅中加油，把虾仁炒至接近熟透，先盛到漏篮中沥去油水。虾仁炒过后还会释出一些水分，先沥干再与蛋液合拌。

### 4. 合拌蛋液

锅中再加油。蛋黄中放入葱花，随后倒入蛋白，快速略拌，再加入沥干的虾仁。准备好盛盘。

### 5. 快炒至熟

把混合好的蛋液和虾仁迅速倒入锅中，用锅铲推拢、翻折。蛋液开始凝固时关火，继续借锅中余温把剩余蛋液煮熟，立即盛出食用。

## 小贴士

- 蛋黄先拌匀再加入蛋白，并保留最后短时间合拌的顺序，不要从开始就把两者完全混在一起。
- 炒虾后先沥水，避免虾仁带着油水进入蛋液。
- 鸡蛋很吸油，炒蛋前要在锅中补油。最后关火，用余温完成凝固。
- 做好马上吃；放置后会出水，影响口感。

## 参考链接

- [原视频](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MzPWOE45YcQ)
bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- 14 fresh shrimp
- 6 eggs
- 1 scallion
- Salt
- Ground pepper
- Starch
- Sesame oil
- A little light soy sauce
- Cooking oil

## Method

### 1. Marinate the shrimp

Peel the shrimp. Add salt, ground pepper, starch and sesame oil, and mix by hand. Finely slice the scallion.

### 2. Handle the eggs separately

Separate the yolks and whites into different bowls. Mix a little light soy sauce into the yolks. Keep the whites separate for now rather than combining everything at the start.

### 3. Cook and drain the shrimp

Add oil to the wok and stir-fry the shrimp until nearly cooked through. Transfer them to a strainer to drain off oil and liquid. Cooked shrimp release some liquid, so drain them before adding them to the eggs.

### 4. Combine the egg mixture

Add more oil to the wok. Add the scallion to the yolks, then pour in the whites and stir briefly. Add the drained shrimp. Have a serving plate ready.

### 5. Quickly cook the eggs

Quickly pour the shrimp and egg mixture into the wok. Push and fold it with a spatula. Once the eggs begin setting, turn off the heat and keep folding so the remaining heat cooks the rest of the egg. Plate and eat immediately.

## Tips

- Mix the yolks first and add the whites only for the final brief mixing. Keep this order rather than fully combining both at the beginning.
- Drain the shrimp after stir-frying so their oil and liquid do not enter the eggs.
- Eggs absorb oil readily, so replenish the wok oil before cooking them. Finish setting the eggs with residual heat after turning off the heat.
- Eat as soon as the dish is ready; standing causes liquid to collect and affects the texture.

title: 鼎爷豉油王炒面
description: 蔬菜与面条分开炒，再用长筷挑散合炒，保持面条干爽。
descriptionEn: Cook the vegetables and noodles separately, then combine them while lifting the strands apart with long chopsticks.
body:
## 食材

- 熟炒面条（沥干、挑散），相当于 4 个面饼的量
- 韭菜半斤
- 银芽半斤
- 红洋葱半个
- 老抽
- 生抽
- 盐
- 食用油
- 白芝麻，装饰用

## 做法

### 1. 切好配菜

红洋葱切细丝，韭菜切段，银芽备好。面条先挑散。

### 2. 先炒蔬菜

锅中加油，放入银芽，用长筷拨散。加入韭菜炒匀，随后加入红洋葱丝，继续翻炒，再把蔬菜全部盛出。

### 3. 把面条炒散

锅中加油，放入挑散的面条。用长筷不断把面条挑起、拨开，同时翻动，使面条逐渐散开，炒至表面干爽。

### 4. 调味后合炒

加入老抽，挑拌至面条均匀上色。把蔬菜倒回锅中，继续挑松、拌匀，加入生抽和盐调味，炒匀后盛盘，撒上白芝麻。

## 小贴士

- 蔬菜先炒后盛出，待面条炒散、上色后才回锅合炒。
- 用长筷把面条挑起、拨散，避免始终让面条结成一团。

bodyEn:
## Ingredients

- Cooked stir-fry noodles, drained and separated, equivalent to 4 noodle cakes
- Half a jin Chinese chives
- Half a jin trimmed bean sprouts
- Half a red onion
- Dark soy sauce
- Light soy sauce
- Salt
- Cooking oil
- White sesame seeds for garnish

## Method

### 1. Prepare the vegetables

Thinly slice the red onion, cut the Chinese chives into sections and prepare the trimmed bean sprouts. Separate the noodles.

### 2. Cook the vegetables first

Add oil to the wok, add the bean sprouts and separate them with long chopsticks. Add the chives and stir-fry, then add the red onion. Continue tossing, then transfer all the vegetables to a plate.

### 3. Separate and fry the noodles

Add oil to the wok and add the separated noodles. Keep lifting and separating them with long chopsticks while tossing them, until the strands loosen and their surface is dry.

### 4. Season and combine

Add dark soy sauce and lift and toss until the noodles are evenly colored. Return the vegetables to the wok. Keep lifting and mixing, add light soy sauce and salt, then toss well and plate. Garnish with white sesame seeds.

## Tips

- Cook and remove the vegetables first. Return them only after separating and coloring the noodles.
- Lift and separate the strands with long chopsticks to prevent the noodles remaining in a clump.
